programme.desc: The design duos get a chance to fix problems or snags in the whole house. Then it is time for the judges to spend the night in the homes for the final judging process.

programme.title: Garden Winner
programme.desc: It is deadline day for the garden challenge, one duo has a burst pipe close to deadline and another illegally works after deadline, will they be disqualified? Who will be crowned as the winners of the garden challenge by our panel of judges?

programme.title: Lounge Challenge
programme.desc: Our design duos get briefed on their seventh and final challenge, decorating the lounge. They meet with their mentors to discuss their ideas

programme.title: Lounge Winners
programme.desc: It is deadline day for the final challenge, the lounge. Will team House and Leisure have pulled off a miracle with their miniscule budget? Who will be crowned as the winners of the lounge challenge by our panel of judges?

programme.title: Africa Everywhere
programme.desc: Washington, D.C. is a place where the ideals of a country are celebrated, big and small. From the sounds of African inspired music to the aroma of Ethiopian coffee, Africa's influence is everywhere, but is America's capital really a place to call home?

programme.title: Africa Everywhere
programme.desc: Once the colonial power, London is waking up and transforming amidst a host of internal issues. For the African Diaspora community in London, these issues often resonate through a different lens.

programme.title: Crimes Uncovered
programme.desc: Shot to death in their home, renowned doctor Anwar Kadwa and his wife Munirah's deaths leave a multitude of questions, who was responsible and what was their motive? A web of deceit is revealed.
programme.sub-title: Flesh and Blood: The Riaz Kadwa Story

programme.title: Crimes Uncovered
programme.desc: Six-month-old Jordan Leigh Norton is fatally wounded during a supposed house burglary, it is then uncovered that baby Jordan was a victim caught in the fatal cross-fire of a violent love triangle.
programme.sub-title: Too Young to Die: The Jordan-Leigh Norton Story

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Case 1: Mrs. Jane is suing Mr. Timothy for the balance owed on a motorcycle he purchased which was stolen shortly after delivery. Case 2: Ms. Abdul is suing Ms. Benson for unpaid phone repair costs, after she only paid for part of the repairs.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Case 1: Kingsley Emeka has dragged his former girlfriend before the judge in a bid to recover Valentines gifts. Case 2: Mr. Zaccheus has brought Mr. Leonard, his friend and 1st time business partner to court for a debt obtained under false pretenses

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Case 1: Kingsley Emeka has dragged his former girlfriend before the judge in a bid to recover Valentines gifts. Case 2: Mr. Zaccheus has brought Mr. Leonard, his friend and 1st time business partner to court for a debt obtained under false pretenses

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Case 1: Esther Asuquor has dragged her rental agent James Ado before the judge in a bid to recover her paid fees for finding her apartment which was already occupied by another tenant.

programme.title: Jason's Letter
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy is still grieving from the loss of his best friend, the most recent of many unarmed shooting victims in his small community. After realizing the marches and protests have done nothing, he decides to take matters into his own hands.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom explore Kyushu, the most southerly of the Japanese main islands. They master the art of making the world famous Tonkotsu Ramen, fashion their own sushi knives with the help of a blacksmith who ordinarily has an eight-year waiting list for his product, and participate in a traditional Japanese tea ceremony.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Kyushu

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom head to Dom's hometown of Manchester, the world's first industrialised city and now a vibrant food capital. They brunch at cult diner Gooey, learn to cook curry at a classic "Rice & Three" café, explore the science behind ice cream cones, and enjoy a special tour of Manchester United's iconic stadium.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Manchester

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane embraces the words of Hippocrates, "Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food." She explores Greek staples-olive oil, herbs, nuts, veggies-as health foundations. Plus, three simple recipes and a chat with Dr. William Li, author of Eat to Beat Disease.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Let Food be Thy Medicine

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: How do you take a meat-centric plate and shift things around so that vegetables take up the prominent place and meat plays a secondary role? Diane and her son Yiorgos explore the geography of the dinner plate by recreating classic Greek recipes for meat with, well, less of it!
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Changing the Geography of the Dinner Plate

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane shares how shopping for, cleaning and cooking greens is easy and accessible. She visits her 96-year-old cousin's garden, this vibrant produce may hold the key to her longevity. In the kitchen, Diane prepares a green storm and sips a surprising elixir from cooked greens.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Greens Rule the Day

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Inspired by the ancient Greek philosopher and mathematician, Pythagoras, Diane explores plant-based cooking rooted in his ancient vegetarian philosophy. She discusses modern nutrition's alignment with Pythagorean principles and chats with Prof. John Wilkins on Ancient Greek foods and medicines.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Plant-Based in Ancient Greece

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Influential Grilling: Scroll through the images on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, and you'll find grilled and smoked dishes of astonishing ingenuity. In the spirit of this new style of barbecue, we've invited three of my favorite influencers to grill with me - Derek Wolf from Over the Fire Cooking, Scott Thomas from Grillin' Fools, and Susie Bulloch from Hey Grill Hey.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Influential Grilling

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Wagyu Demystified: Wagyu, "Japanese cow" literally, was once an obscure cattle breed from Japan. Today, it's on restaurant menus and in butcher shops around the world. Get ready for a sumptuous Japanese A5 Rib-Eye with sesame salt and grilled rice cakes, followed by wagyu steak tomahawks with fire-roasted marrow. Then feast your eyes on wagyu smash burgers with parmesan crisps.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wagyu Demystified

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Barbecue Takes Flight: What's America's most popular meat? It's Poultry. Americans consume more than 112 pounds per person each year. Today Steven prepares an astonishing array of grilled poultry from brandy brined rotisserie chicken to duck legs flame roasted Peking-style. And with a special guest a Project Fire first: turkey "ribs"-found in St. Louis, and virtually nowhere else.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Takes Flight

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The largest indoor market in Budapest is also the most elegant in Europe! Spanning over three levels, the impressive central food market is long recognized as a marvel. Whether it be the freshest fish, the richest goose liver, or the sweetest paprika that you're looking for, you'll find it. But don't forget the basement: this is where you will find the very best pickled cabbage in the country!
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Budapest

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Placed in the middle of Palermo's ancient streets, it is almost difficult to walk. All around there is a swarm of colors and perfumes. There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Heritage of the Lowcountry

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia brings us into her garden and teaches us about small space gardening, container gardening, and how to make the most of the land around you, no matter your constraints. Along the way she talks with community leaders on what it takes to compost and start a community garden. Georgia also takes us back to her kitchen to share some of her favorite garden recipes.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Garden

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. We follow her as she prepares and gathers her ingredients - we meet a small town chicken farmer, gather produce at the local farmers market, and set the table at a local textile studio where Georgia learns to dye napkins.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Discover Your Roots

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Join Georgia on an urban foraging expedition and learn from an edible and medicinal plants expert as he and Georgia collect a variety of items during a walk through the neighborhood. From flower studded ice cubes, to honeysuckle tea, to dandelion green salad, Georgia is making the most of what is around her.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Wild

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Women from around the country convene in west Texas for a transformative experience in the wild. During the episode, Georgia teaches viewers about the different cuts of venison and the ways to cook them, as well as how to save money by grinding your own meat. The guests and viewers will leave feeling empowered and with a different perspective on what it is to be a human and an omnivore.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Go West, Young Woman

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia hosts a dinner party at her home in Austin, Texas, focusing on ingredients that are as locally sourced and homemade as possible. Pulling produce from her own garden, she turns it into pickled vegetables, tomato bread salad, a lemon balm cocktail and more! Georgia even decorates the dinner table entirely with items she has found in nature.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Entertaining at Home

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia is in Charleston, South Carolina where she is preparing a dinner at historic Fenwick Hall. She invites a legendary queen of Southern cooking to come by and teach her the secret to her two ingredient biscuits, learns a Nigerian inspired cocktail from a local sommelier, and heads out on the water to harvest oysters. Georgia also shares her tips for setting a southern outdoor table.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Artisans of Charleston

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia visits Tuscany to get back to her own roots, and learn about the generations of families who are carrying on their family's traditions, some for centuries. She goes truffle hunting, learns to make fresh pasta, how to taste wine, and samples the incredible cheeses from the sheep grazing in front of her - experiencing the true value in living off the land.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Traditions in Tuscany

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the "7-generation framework" - their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In preparation for a dinner party, Georgia searches for wild edibles in unlikely places, and pays a visit to a pair of women glass blowers who create works of usable art in their glass studio in Brooklyn, New York. They work together to make glass pieces for the dinner table. Georgia brings us back to the kitchen to cook delicious dishes and set a table with their glassware.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Earth, Women, Fire

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In the orchards of upstate New York, Georgia Pellegrini explores the idea of "uncultivation"--a way of working with nature rather than controlling it. From regenerative apple growing to slow-crafted cider and brandy, she meets makers who transform fruit into something lasting, revealing how time, patience and imperfection shape both flavor and meaning.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Apples

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In Maine, Georgia Pellegrini explores the delicate balance between wild ecosystems and the people who steward them. From ancient wild blueberry barrens to regenerative oyster farms and cutting-edge marine research, she follows a network of growers, fishers and scientists working in sync with nature -- revealing how diversity, care and innovation can sustain both food systems and the future.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Maine

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In the Western Catskills, Georgia Pellegrini follows a young couple who return to a childhood home and reimagine it as a regenerative farm. Through soil, animals and shared meals, they rediscover a deeper connection to land and community -- revealing how staying, tending and working with nature can transform both a place and the people who call it home.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Uplands

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In Texas, Georgia Pellegrini traces the story of yaupon -- North America's only native source of caffeine. Once dismissed as a nuisance, this plant reveals a deeper story: of land out of balance, of restoration through stewardship and of Indigenous traditions nearly lost. As farmers, scientists and communities reconnect with yaupon, it becomes a bridge between ecology, culture and renewal.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Yaupon

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In the Ozark hills of Missouri, Georgia Pellegrini steps inside East Wind Community -- an egalitarian experiment in shared living. Here, land, labor and resources are held in common, and decisions are made collectively. As she joins daily life and conversation, she explores what it means to build a life rooted in cooperation and a more connected, communal way of living.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - East Wind

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In a quiet winter landscape, Georgia Pellegrini explores a more thoughtful holiday -- one rooted in simplicity, sustainability and handmade tradition. From repurposed treasures to shared meals and creative rituals, she visits kindred spirits who reveal how small, meaningful moments -- the "glimmers" -- can transform the season into something lasting.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Christmas

programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Lying in the culinary heart of Vienna like an island, a little world of treats rises in the midst: the Naschmarkt food market. A throng of buyers and curious onlookers meander through the stalls all consumed by the scent of spices, distracted by the smell of sausage, and stunned by the diversity of turnips, tubers, foliage, and fruit on display. The Naschmarkt truly is Vienna's most popular belly.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Vienna

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The market of San Benedetto in Cagliari is the island's belly. It is one of the biggest fresh produce markets in Europe and arguably said to be the biggest fish market in Europe. A paradise for food lovers, where every stall keeper has a story to tell.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cagliari

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's show is a special celebration of Julie's favorite season, Spring! This refreshing time of year puts a smile on Julie's face focusing her cooking on springtime offerings. What better way for Julie to cook, create and celebrate this sensational season than with her crown roasted leg of lamb infused with a bouquet of fresh herbs, slowly roasted, makes the centerpiece on the springtime table!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Spring Sensations

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Julie makes her Mezze magical in a stunning and scrumptious presentation of her Lebanese cultures most famous small plates perfectly plated for her loving Lebanese family to savor! Mezze, internationally known all over the world as one of the most distinctive and delicious display of dishes to discover originating from Lebanon and Middle East. Julie Taboulie's Mezze makes entertaining enchanting.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Magical Mezze Amidst the Moonlight

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: On today's show, a fresh farmer's market is inspiring Julie to make her marvelous Makbouseh, a Lebanese-style summertime squash stew. Julie's Makbouseh, a magnificent medley of fresh vegetables and array of amazing aromatics slowly simmer into a scrumptious squash stew, sure to be a staple at your table. Fresh from the farmer's market to a mouthwatering Lebanese masterpiece you won't want to miss.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Meet Me At The Market

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Join the "Queen of Lebanese Cuisine", Julie Taboulie, as she pays a special tribute to her namesake dish and her culinary traditions. Throughout this visually vibrant show, Julie takes viewers back to memory lane of her Lebanese heritage and authentic dishes she grew up eating ever since she was a young girl at her family's Lebanese table. It's tart, it's tangy, it's tasty. It's Julie's Taboulie!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - It's Taboulie Time

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: In this sensational season opener, Julie finds herself in a garden of dreams in Mama's Glorious Garden. Special Mama and garden serves as Julie's number one source of inspiration, ideas influencing her to cook, create and celebrate her impressive line-up of fresh, flavorful, fabulous Lebanese foods. More garden, more glory, most of all more Mama in Julie's garden of dreams, dig into deliciousness!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Garden of Dreams

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: STOP! And, smell the roses with Julie's rose water signature scented sweets hailing from Lebanon and the Middle East. Beautiful and breathtaking rose gardens inspire Julie's baking. Julie's rose water signature sweets will surely have you stopping to smell the roses, inspiring you to create her sweets for yourself right at home as she simply shows you how step-by-step in true Julie Taboulie style.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Stop & Smell The Roses

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Special seasonal sweets straight from Lebanon and Middle East always signify the holiday season for Julie as she warmly welcomes you into her home for Christmas and the Holiday season. This special show Julie is masterfully making and baking some of the most famous sweets, her personal favorite and most popular requested recipes, Baklawa and Knefeh pastries from Julie's Lebanese kitchen to yours!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Lebanese Sweets for the Holiday Season

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Julie's falling for Fattoush and you will be too. Her Lebanese peasant-style bread salad is sure to become your new favorite, it's full of flavor and fresh surprises! This spectacular salad is tossed together with Julie's homemade crispy crunchy, toasted-to-perfection pita bread, tossed in Julie's lemony vinaigrette, seasoned with sumac, it's key ingredient, makes this famous salad so satisfying.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Falling for Fattoush

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: It can be a challenge to put dinner together in a working household. And then what happens when you're working opposite shifts? Ellie helps a frazzled couple trying to get healthy weeknight dinners on the table when conflicting schedules and priorities intervene. Recipes include Shrimp with Spinach, Garlic and Smoked Paprika, Peach Chicken with Crispy Bread Crumbs, and Mango-Coconut Sorbet.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Crazy Schedule Dinner Challenge

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food

It's Ellie to the rescue with flexible recipes that will bring them together. Recipes include Warm Spinach Salad with grilled sirloin, Panzanella with White Beans with chicken sausage, Forbidden Rice Bowl, and Grilled veggies & lamb kabobs served with Tahini Sauce.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Herbivore VS Carnivore

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food

Recipes include Asian Shrimp Cakes served with Avocado-Wasabi Sauce, Chicken Phyllo Pies, Broccoli & Sun-Dried Tomato Flatbread, and more.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - It's My Party

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Americans get more than 25% of calories from snacks. Ellie shows how to make them count with some great ways to satisfy the cravings we get around the clock. Recipes include 3-ingredient Chocolate Grape Banana Skewers, Nutty Oatmeal Bars, Spring Cottage Peas with Basil, and Hummus with Cumin-Roasted Carrots.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Snack Attack

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food

Recipes include 3-Ingredient seasoned breadcrumbs, Tilapia Milanese with breadcrumbs, Green Tea Poached Salmon with Asian Slaw, and Bouillabaisse.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - How To Fish

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Tired of snoring through your salad? Shake up the same-old same-old with some recipes that awaken all the senses. programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Unboring Salads

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Journey back in time to uncover Boone's historic roots and savor its vibrant culinary scene. Delve into the historic Tatum Cabin, where delightful recipes are prepared, capturing the essence of Boone's heritage.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Flavors of the High Country - Boone, North Carolina

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib travels to the enchanting Pacific island of New Caledonia and discovers the harmonious fusion of French and indigenous Kanaky culture and the mouthwatering cuisine born from this blend. From a centuries-old Bougna recipe to the French pastry shops that dot the capital city, New Caledonia is a culinary treasure.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Paris of the Pacific - New Caledonia

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib explores the rich cultural heritage of New York City. At the historic Harriton house, Chef Staib prepares recipes that pay homage to New York's roots.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Melting Pot Metropolis - New York City

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Embark on a captivating history of Machias, Maine and the first naval battle of the Revolutionary War. Gain insight into the region's sustainable practices and the symbiotic relationship between the land and sea. Inspired by the local bounty, Chef Staib creates mouthwatering recipes that celebrate this remarkable coastal town.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Tides of a Revolution - The Battle of Machias Bay

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Travel to Old Fort Harrod in Harrodsburg, Kentucky to explore the history of the fort and life of James Harrod. Joined by Mary Barlow, Chef Walter Staib pays tribute to the culinary heritage in the George Rogers Clark Cabin, they prepare historic recipes including a Kentucky Elk roast and a delightful Stack Cake, showcasing the traditional flavors of the region.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Birthplace of Kentucky - Harrodsburg, Kentucky

programme.title: A Taste of History

Get ready for a sizzling adventure that celebrates the flavors of Australia in true "Barbie" style!
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Grilling Down Under - New South Wales, Australia

programme.title: A Taste of History

programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - A Multicultural Menu - Victoria, Australia

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib explores Delaware's pivotal role in American history while savoring mouthwatering dishes like Spicy Corn Relish, Stewed Codfish, and Macaroons. programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Flavors of the First State - Delaware

programme.title: A Taste of History

programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Savoring Oaxaca - The Spirit of Mezcal

programme.title: A Taste of History

programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Applejack - The Original Colonial Elixir

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul

programme.sub-title: Mycenae - Where Kings Planned the Trojan War

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: Ragnar and Lagertha's fleets depart Kattegat once more for Wessex and this time they bring a group to colonize there. King Ecbert hosts the Norsemen and proposes a deal. Despite the misgivings of some of the other leaders, Ragnar leads his forces into battle once more, but this time as allies of Wessex.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: Lagertha and Athelstan help to establish the Viking settlement in Wessex. Harbard, a mysterious wanderer, arrives in Kattegat, realizing the forewarned dreams of Aslaug, Siggy and Helga.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown and rebuffs criticism from his leading nobles. The Wessex/Viking forces charge into battle with Mercia. In Kattegat, Harbard arrives in to the Great Hall and his mysterious aura fascinates Aslaug and Helga but Siggy remains suspicious. There are strange and tragic happenings in Kattegat and Siggy suspects Harbard is the cause.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The victorious Wessex/Viking forces return to Wessex but there is rancour in the Viking camp - Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert and is resentful the influence that he feels Athelstan has over Ragnar. Princess Kwenthrith makes some calculating political moves following the battle at the Hill of the Ash in Mercia. Visitors from the past arrive in Hederby, at Kalf's invitation.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The fleet returns to Kattegat to find tragic circumstances await. Lagertha learns that her Earldom has been usurped and convinces Ragnar to travel to Hederby with her in an effort to reclaim her title. Ragnar causes great surprise when he announces the next raid. The Seer has interesting prophecies for Rollo.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up pace, and Rollo ponders the Seer's prophecy about his destiny. Ragnar is informed of Aethelwulf's massacre at the settlement in Wessex, and Kalf arrives in Kattegat with some new allies and some familiar faces. Porunn and Judith both deliver children; but with new life there is also death.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The appearance of the Viking fleet causes panic among the population of Paris. The defense of Paris is in the hands of its Commander, Count Odo, who is confident that the city is prepared for the attack. The Emperor Charles, urged by his daughter Gisla, announces in Court he will remain in the city. The Vikings establish camp downriver from the city and plan their attack.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The Viking army embarks and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense, overseen by Count Odo. The Vikings are determined to make it through the gates of Paris and conquer the city; they will stop at nothing to succeed.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The Vikings go all out for a second assault on Paris. Recognizing the desperate state of affairs for his city, Emperor Charles must make a difficult decision. In Wessex, Judith is compelled to make a difficult decision of her own.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: Rollo's destiny is recognized and Bjorn steps up as a leader. With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar and his Vikings troops take a daring chance.

programme.desc: In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what's left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.

programme.title: Fort Bowie
programme.desc: Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.

programme.title: Fort Defiance
programme.desc: In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother...who is blind.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks
programme.desc: In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

programme.title: Michael Cimino's Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite
programme.desc: The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programme.desc: From director Tonino Valerii comes this top-notch spaghetti western set during the Civil War where eight condemned Union prisoners attempt to capture a Missouri fort from Confederate soldiers. James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer star.

programme.title: Cannon For Cordoba
programme.desc: Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

programme.title: The King And Four Queens
programme.desc: Clark Gable is a smooth as ever in this unique blend of action, comedy and western intrigue as he romances the stunning Eleanor Parker -- and three other women -- in the hopes that one of them knows the location of a hidden cache of stolen gold.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

programme.title: The Indian Fighter
programme.desc: Screen Legends Kirk Douglas and Walter Matthau co-star in this exciting account of a man who made his name fighting Indians, but who now must use his peacekeeping skills to keep wronged Sioux warriors from exacting vengeance upon a nearby fort.

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

programme.title: Barbershop (2002)
programme.desc: Ice Cube headlines a stellar cast this hit comedy about a southside Chicago barbershop.

programme.title: Barbershop 2: Back In Business
programme.desc: Calvin (Ice Cube) is struggling to keep his father's shop alive, competing with a name-brand chain next door!

programme.title: Beauty Shop
programme.desc: When her egotistical boss pushes her a hair too far, top stylist Gina decides to open her own beauty shop!

programme.title: Holiday Heart
programme.desc: Holiday (Ving Rhames), a choirmaster by day and a talented female impersonator by night, is lonely and grieving the death of his lover...until he befriends a bright young girl and her drug-addicted mother (Alfre Woodard).

programme.title: Street Smart
programme.desc: A freelance journalist becomes the toast of the town when he breaks a story about the dirty deeds of a ruthless New York pimp. There's only one problem: Jonathan fabricated the entire thing.

programme.title: Gang Related
programme.desc: Two killers are hiding where no one will ever find them...behind their badges! Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg), the city's toughest cop, is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: Police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) discovers that he's the only one who believes that his childhood friend was framed for murder to protect the local tourism business.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: A straight-laced and successful executive's world is turned upside-down when he discovers the 17-year-old son he never knew he had: Roger (Denzel Washington in his feature film debut)!

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Two best friends in 1964 Chicago cope with the challenges of everyday life and life in the housing projects.

programme.title: A Family Thing
programme.desc: When Earl (Robert Duvall) learns he has a Black half-brother (James Earl Jones) in Chicago, he heads north.

programme.title: Salt & Pepper
programme.desc: Legendary Rat-Packers Sammy Davis, Jr., and Peter Lawford star as London's hippest nightclub owners who take on England's craziest criminals!

programme.title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
programme.desc: A slick comedy that blows the 70s Blaxploitation movies right out of the hood! A decorated war hero, returns to the ghetto and enlist an army of original gangstas to clean it up in this mixture of nostalgia, silliness and unpredictable humor.

programme.title: Fame (2009)
programme.desc: An inspiring story of a group of dancers, singers, musicians and actors at the NYC School of Performing Arts.

programme.title: Bojangles
programme.desc: Bill "Bojangles" Robinson (Gregory Hines) overcomes the prejudice of the time and his own personal demons to become a master craftsman...and a legendary entertainer!

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles. Nichelle Nichols also stars.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: An ex-Vietnam, ex-Green Beret captain (Jim Brown) is out to avenge the murder of his parents by the psychotic Dominic Hoffo (Rip Torn).

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: Sentenced to life in the world's most notorious prison colony, two tougher-than-nails inmates enact the ultimate jail break.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: When Harlem gangsters mess with the Mafia, an unlikely pair of New York's finest must work together to bring justice to the streets!

programme.title: Cotton Comes To Harlem
programme.desc: Two New York detectives suddenly find themselves on a wild goose chase for stolen cash that takes them from the Apollo Theater through the heart and soul of Harlem!

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is a professional killer. Now, on the eve of his retirement, he must make a deadly decision.

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: When wild child Anna Lucasta (Eartha Kitt) is thrown out of the house by her self-righteous father, she falls into the life of prostitution... and into the arms of street-wise sailor Danny Johnson (Sammy Davis, Jr.).

programme.title: Lilies Of The Field
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier stars as an itinerant handyman who stops to help five impoverished nuns in the Arizona desert.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: Lt. Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier), asks to be assigned to the case of a reverend accused of murder in San Francisco in hopes of clearing his friend's name.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier is back as Lt. Virgil Tibbs! When six masked figures rob a seemingly normal furniture factory, they leave with a multimillion-dollar cache of heroin!
