programme.title: The Mummy's Ghost
programme.desc: A 3000-year-old limping mummy (Lon Chaney) seeks his reincarnated princess (Ramsay Ames) in a Midwestern college town.

programme.title: The Mummy's Hand
programme.desc: In Cairo, archaeologist Steve Banning (Dick Foran) unearths a vase that he believes could lead him to the ancient tomb of Princess Ananka. Unknown to Steve, his colleague, Professor Andoheb (George Zucco), is also the High Priest of Karnak who holds the secrets of Karas, a mummy who guards Ananka's tomb. Upon receiving funds from magician Solvani (Cecil Kellaway) and his daughter, Marta (Peggy Moran), Steve and the Solvanis embark on an expedition to the grave site, where Karas awaits.

programme.title: The Mummy's Tomb
programme.desc: Old archaeologist (Dick Foran) recalls mummy (Lon Chaney) at large in New England.

programme.title: Night Creatures
programme.desc: Pirate Captain Clegg (Peter Cushing), an English vicar by day, leads ghostly mounted smugglers by night.

programme.title: Night Monster
programme.desc: A man (Lionel Atwill) uses mind over matter to replace his legs, then hunts the doctors who took them.

programme.title: The Night Walker
programme.desc: A lawyer (Robert Taylor) advises a blind man's rich widow (Barbara Stanwyck) tormented by nightmares.

programme.title: The People Under the Stairs
programme.desc: When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Talented Christine (Susanna Foster) is unaware that her singing lessons are being funded by a secret admirer, Enrique (Claude Rains), a mysterious violinist with a disfigured face. Christine's colleagues become suspicious when mysterious accidents start occurring at the Paris Opera House, as the deaths coincide with her meteoric rise to stardom. Christine's suitors, Raoul (Edgar Barrier) and Anatole (Nelson Eddy), brave the dark recesses of the opera house to find the true culprit.

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Composer Lord Ambrose D'Arcy (Michael Gough) and his backer, Harry Hunter (Edward De Souza), struggle to find a replacement for the female lead in their new opera after she quits in the wake of a gruesome murder. When a new prospect, the nubile Christine Charles (Heather Sears), disappears, Harry cautiously investigates. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked man (Herbert Lom) who is eerily familiar with the opera holds Christine captive and offers to groom her to play the part.

programme.title: Revenge of the Creature
programme.desc: Florida aquarium workers (John Agar, Lori Nelson, John Bromfield) communicate by cattle prod with a captured gill-man.

programme.title: She-Wolf of London
programme.desc: Grisly murders convince a turn-of-the-century Londoner that she is the latest in a long line of werewolves.

programme.title: Son of Dracula
programme.desc: Count Alucard (Lon Chaney) makes Southern belle (Louise Allbritton) his bride.

programme.title: Son of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Baron Wolf von Frankenstein is determined to prove the legitimacy of his father's scientific work, thus rescuing the family name from disgrace. With the help of Ygor, a grave robber, Wolf successfully reanimates the monster his father originally brought back from the dead. But when several villagers are killed mysteriously, Wolf must find the culprit in order to vindicate his creation, or face the possibility that he may be responsible.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: Tarantula
programme.desc: Desert scientists (John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll) try to stop a fortified spider the size of a building.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: The Werewolf of London
programme.desc: While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami, who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: When plans for a weekend vacation hit a dead end, friends find themselves stranded in unfamiliar territory, pursued by a bloodthirsty predator. Holed up in an isolated cabin, the friends must fight to survive as the body count rises.

programme.title: The Atticus Institute
programme.desc: In the early 1970s, Dr. Henry West creates an institute to find people with supernatural abilities. When Judith Winstead comes to the facility, she exhibits amazing abilities that the military wants to turn into a weapon.

programme.title: Beneath
programme.desc: Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

programme.title: The Birds II: Land's End
programme.desc: Killer birds infest a seaside town where parents (Brad Johnson, Chelsea Field) take their children for vacation.

programme.title: The Black Castle
programme.desc: An Englishman (Richard Greene) enters an Austrian nobleman's (Stephen McNally) castle, complete with torture chamber and alligator moat.

programme.title: Blood Creek
programme.desc: Two brothers become entangled in a sinister Nazi's occult experiment at an American farmhouse.

programme.title: Captive Wild Woman
programme.desc: A mad doctor (John Carradine) turns an animal trainer's (Milburn Stone) ape into Paula the ape-woman (Acquanetta).

programme.title: Cherry Falls
programme.desc: A small-town sheriff, Brent Marken (Michael Biehn), discovers the presence of a serial killer in his sleepy hamlet. Since the perpetrator has been targeting only virgins, both male and female, the deaths cause panic in much of the local high school population. Sheriff Marken's daughter, Jody (Brittany Murphy), is among the potential victims, since she has yet to sleep with her boyfriend, Kenny Ascott (Gabriel Mann). Can the lawman stop the killer before he goes after Jody?

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
programme.desc: A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.

The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.desc: Un abogado americano cumple su amenaza de acabar con la familia de un hacendado cuando este le niega sus tierras.

programme.desc: Un mecánico se topa con unos ladrones que huyen de la policía quienes dejan caer una bolsa llena de dinero.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.desc: Pastor de la Primera Iglesia Bautista de Dallas, Texas, y autor, el Dr. Robert Jeffress, ofrece a los espectadores y feligreses una colección de aplicaciones prácticas e inspiradoras derivadas de las Sagradas Escrituras para la sociedad actual.

programme.title: Lo sobrenatural ahora
programme.desc: El Apóstol Guillermo Maldonado demuestra el extraordinario poder de Dios y los milagros imposibles.

programme.title: Aqua viva con Sergio Hornung
programme.desc: Aqua Viva presenta al Pastor Sergio Hornung cada semana compartiendo un mensaje cargado de fe, vision y herramientas practicas, a fin de experimentar una genuina transformación por el poder del Espíritu Santo.

programme.title: En contacto con Dr. Charles Stanley
programme.desc: Pastor Dr. Charles Stanley usa sus diversos programas y ministerio para difundir el Evangelio a la población del mundo, y utiliza sus predicaciones para convencer a los seguidores del cristianismo a mantener una relación más estrecha con Jesucristo.

programme.title: Christian Worship Hour
programme.desc: La Hora de Adoración Cristiana con el Dr. Harold E. Salem proclama la Palabra de Dios con sencillez y humildad en toda su verdad y pureza, con especial preocupación y compasión por los perdidos y con esperanza y ánimo por todos los creyentes.

programme.title: Jentezen Franklin
programme.desc: Encuentre respuestas en la Palabra de Dios y aprenda a vivir cada día con un propósito y significado mientras Jentezen Franklin presenta la verdad clara y simple que lo inspirará a ser lo mejor posible.

programme.title: Adoración en casa
programme.desc: Transforme la atmósfera de lo que sea que esté enfrentando a través del poder de la adoración con Josh Morales.

programme.title: Fe y Fuego
programme.desc: El Señor planta sueños en nuestro corazón, y estos pueden florecer cuando el suelo es fértil. Pongamos la mirada en lo que está delante y preparemos nuestra alma para alcanzar nueva esperanza, nuevas metas y cumplir sus sueños en nosotros.

programme.title: Descubriendo al Jesús Judío
programme.desc: Desde el Monte de los Olivos, el rabino Schneider revela el profundo significado de la ascensión de Jesús. Acompaña al rabino a descubrir cómo este acontecimiento crucial cumple las profecías del Antiguo Testamento.

programme.title: En Familia con Luis y Kristen
programme.desc: El pacto matrimonial trae consigo una gran recompensa, el día de hoy veremos el poder de este pacto y cómo podemos mantenernos firmes en nuestro matrimonio.

programme.title: Jason Lozano

programme.title: Una Voz de Sanidad
programme.desc: Una Voz de Sanidad es un programa de fe, milagros, sanidad y liberación que lleva esperanza y el poder transformador de Dios a nivel mundial.

As the crew enjoys the autumn flavors, they discuss Thanksgiving versus Friendsgiving, dive into a comprehensive timeline for holiday prep, and give away a prize to a lucky fan from Oregon.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: It's Thanksgiving Eve, and Carla Hall takes the stress out of holiday cooking with her fast and flavorful Turkey Scallopini topped with a Cranberry Gastrique. The hosts share their best organizational tips, including Michael's famous oven grid and platter sticky notes. The trio also swaps hilarious stories about cooking under pressure and celebrity encounters.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: It's the Friday after Thanksgiving, and Chewed Up is all about transforming leftovers into brand-new masterpieces. Carla Hall whips up a decadent Ice Cream Pecan Pie using leftover pie slices, while Michael Symon cooks a savory Stuffing Frittata. The hosts confess their favorite late-night leftover habits, debate mayonnaise brands, and share wild stories about flying with pets.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon dive into an episode celebrating coffee and food pairing. The hosts prepare two standout recipes: a homemade Cinnamon Coffee Cake perfect for breakfast or dessert, and an authentic Buena Vista–Style Irish Coffee that brings San Francisco cafe tradition into home kitchens. Viewers get insider tips and techniques from three seasoned culinary professionals.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon demonstrates how to make Korean-style short ribs using a quick grilling method combined with a flavorful Asian pear-based marinade featuring soy, mirin, gojuchang, and sesame oil. The thin-cut ribs marinate for 6-12 hours to tenderize, then grill for just 3 minutes per side over high heat. Michael garnishes the finished ribs with crispy scallions, cilantro, a sesame-chili mix, and lime. Meanwhile, Liz Symon prepares a refreshing soju mojito by muddling fresh mint and lime, then adding soju, lime juice, and maple syrup for depth. Liv Annacone joins the hosts as they discuss the ease and flavor of both dishes.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon shares comprehensive garlic education on this Halloween-themed episode of Chewed Up, demonstrating proper peeling methods using a bowl-shaking technique, various cutting approaches including microplane mincing and hand-slicing, and the benefits of removing garlic germs to reduce bitterness. He advocates strongly for using whole fresh garlic rather than pre-peeled or jarred varieties, explaining how commercial processing compromises flavor. The episode culminates with preparation of luxurious Robuchon-style mashed potatoes—equal parts potatoes and butter—garnished with roasted garlic cloves, Parmigiano-Reggiano, fresh chives, and served alongside grilled garlic bread.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon prepares the famous Fat Doug burger, a signature dish from his former restaurant B Spot Burgers that won the Sobey Burger Bash championship twice. The burger features crispy pastrami, melted Swiss cheese, and tangy coleslaw on a potato roll. Meanwhile, co-host Liz Symon creates an improvisational cherry cola cocktail made with Averna Amaro, Cointreau, amaretto cherries, and seltzer that unexpectedly tastes remarkably like classic Coke. The episode explores the burger's history, cooking technique over live fire, and the importance of quality ingredients and balanced flavors.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon prepares the famous Fat Doug burger, a signature dish from his former restaurant B Spot Burgers that won the Sobey Burger Bash championship twice. programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: In this summer picnic episode, Michael Symon and Clinton Kelly are joined by celebrated chef Ayesha Nurdjaja to explore classic picnic fare with cultural roots. Ayesha shares her family's cherished recipe for a Potato Egg Provolone Semolina Hero, a humble yet satisfying dish that speaks to her Brooklyn heritage and Italian-Indonesian background. The hosts discuss picnic traditions, sandwich preferences, and the art of making the perfect egg dish. The episode includes a blind taste-identification game with picnic basket items and closes with fan mail discussing induction stoves, overhyped foods, and emerging culinary talents to watch.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: The Chewed Up Show dives into world-class dips with hosts Michael Symon and Clinton Kelly, joined by guest Ayesha Nurdjaja. Clinton prepares a simple homemade tzatziki with Greek yogurt, cucumber, garlic, and fresh herbs, discussing how it's become a healthy staple in his household. Carla brings a grilled corn dip featuring mayo, sour cream, scallions, cilantro, and charred corn. Michael shares a Cleveland clam dip recipe—a regional specialty featuring diced clams, bacon, dill, and sour cream. The hosts discuss dip culture, texture preferences, and creative variations like using kohlrabi and roasted beets. Between recipes, they play never-have-I-ever games and answer fan questions about dessert preferences and vacation spots.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: The Chewed Up Show hosts Michael Symon, Clinton Kelly, and guest Leo Galletto explore the world of ice cream sandwiches. The episode opens with a blind vanilla ice cream tasting of four popular brands, where the hosts evaluate texture, flavor, and mouthfeel before selecting the best option for ice cream sandwich construction. Leo then showcases two signature recipes: Chocolate Strawberry Ice Cream Sandwiches featuring double chocolate chip cookies with strawberry jam and freeze-dried strawberries, and a Tipsy 10 PM Ice Cream Sandwich—a late-night creation made with peanut butter, crushed peanuts, vanilla ice cream, and chocolate sauce on a potato roll. The episode includes personal stories about past episodes and karaoke memories with Leo.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Hosts Michael Symon and Clinton Kelly welcome chef Amanda Freitag to tackle the humble canned tuna. The episode features a blind taste test comparing four popular tuna brands—Bumblebee, Wild Planet, Tonino, and Genova—evaluating flavor, texture, and value. The hosts discuss childhood tuna memories and debate the merits of water-packed versus oil-packed varieties. Symon then demonstrates how to elevate canned tuna by preparing a gourmet sandwich featuring homemade romesco sauce, quality olive oil–packed tuna, sliced tomato, fresh basil, and grilled bread. The segment celebrates using classic pantry ingredients creatively while learning proper techniques.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Hosts Michael Symon and Clinton Kelly welcome back Chef Jackie Bakula, known as "Sparkles," to share no-bake recipes perfect for hot summer days. Jackie demonstrates how to make burrata with frozen strawberries—a simple four-ingredient dish featuring room-temperature cheese contrasted with bone-chillingly cold grated frozen fruit, finished with balsamic glaze, Maldon salt, and fresh basil. The hosts discuss Jackie's journey from working on The Chew at age 21 to building her social media presence by cooking authentically for her family rather than chasing viral trends. They also play a game of "Crave It, Save It, Skip It" with summer beverages and cocktails, reminisce about favorite dishes from The Chew, and share what they're excited about for the future.

Yikes! Is it any good? Are the kids maybe onto something here? Can John come up with a recipe that elevates it from the bottom shelf to...a slightly higher shelf? We feel old.

programme.title: Ying Cooks the Internet
programme.desc: "McDonald's General Tso's Chicken" - Chris Ying has seen all of the McDonald's "hacks" that are floating around social media, and he's calling BS. Most of these don't even qualify as actual hacks, so he takes matters into his own hands and concocts a clever dish using Chicken McNuggets, Sweet Sour sauce, ketchup, (and a few other things you'd have in your kitchen) to truly upgrade your McDonald's meal.

programme.title: Ying Cooks the Internet
programme.desc: "A Complete Christmas Roast Beef Dinner" - The internet is full of people advertising their recipes for affordable! simple! budget-buster! Christmas dinners. But just because you want to save some money and not break your back making dinner doesn't mean you don't want something festive and celebratory. Chris Ying is here to light the way to a full Christmas dinner—roast beef, horseradish cream, creamed spinach, baked potatoes, Yorkshire pudding—for under $50. Nothing hacky or gimmick-y about it. Just a good old-fashioned heart-warming holiday dinner from Colonel Christmas himself.

programme.title: Ying Cooks the Internet
programme.desc: "Chris Ying's Family Curry Recipe with Twice-Fried Potatoes, Chicken, and Roux-Thickened Coconut Milk" - It's Chris Ying's favorite dish on earth. His last-request meal. It's his dad's curry: a version of Macanese (as in, from Macao) Chicken: a roux-thickened coconut curry full of twice-fried potatoes and fried chicken thighs, flavored with ginger and Shaoxing wine. It's Chris's comfort food, which is fitting, since he's feeling a little emotionally battered as he makes it for us. Will the curry do its magic and pick him up? Only one way to find out!

programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Join Georgia on an urban foraging expedition and learn from an edible and medicinal plants expert as he and Georgia collect a variety of items during a walk through the neighborhood. From flower studded ice cubes, to honeysuckle tea, to dandelion green salad, Georgia is making the most of what is around her.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Women from around the country convene in west Texas for a transformative experience in the wild. During the episode, Georgia teaches viewers about the different cuts of venison and the ways to cook them, as well as how to save money by grinding your own meat. The guests and viewers will leave feeling empowered and with a different perspective on what it is to be a human and an omnivore.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia hosts a dinner party at her home in Austin, Texas, focusing on ingredients that are as locally sourced and homemade as possible. Pulling produce from her own garden, she turns it into pickled vegetables, tomato bread salad, a lemon balm cocktail and more! Georgia even decorates the dinner table entirely with items she has found in nature.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia is in Charleston, South Carolina where she is preparing a dinner at historic Fenwick Hall. She invites a legendary queen of Southern cooking to come by and teach her the secret to her two ingredient biscuits, learns a Nigerian inspired cocktail from a local sommelier, and heads out on the water to harvest oysters. Georgia also shares her tips for setting a southern outdoor table.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia visits Tuscany to get back to her own roots, and learn about the generations of families who are carrying on their family's traditions, some for centuries. She goes truffle hunting, learns to make fresh pasta, how to taste wine, and samples the incredible cheeses from the sheep grazing in front of her - experiencing the true value in living off the land.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the “7-generation framework” – their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In preparation for a dinner party, Georgia searches for wild edibles in unlikely places, and pays a visit to a pair of women glass blowers who create works of usable art in their glass studio in Brooklyn, New York. They work together to make glass pieces for the dinner table. Georgia brings us back to the kitchen to cook delicious dishes and set a table with their glassware.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In the orchards of upstate New York, Georgia Pellegrini explores the idea of “uncultivation”--a way of working with nature rather than controlling it. From regenerative apple growing to slow-crafted cider and brandy, she meets makers who transform fruit into something lasting, revealing how time, patience and imperfection shape both flavor and meaning.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In Maine, Georgia Pellegrini explores the delicate balance between wild ecosystems and the people who steward them. From ancient wild blueberry barrens to regenerative oyster farms and cutting-edge marine research, she follows a network of growers, fishers and scientists working in sync with nature -- revealing how diversity, care and innovation can sustain both food systems and the future.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In the Western Catskills, Georgia Pellegrini follows a young couple who return to a childhood home and reimagine it as a regenerative farm. Through soil, animals and shared meals, they rediscover a deeper connection to land and community -- revealing how staying, tending and working with nature can transform both a place and the people who call it home.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In Texas, Georgia Pellegrini traces the story of yaupon -- North America’s only native source of caffeine. Once dismissed as a nuisance, this plant reveals a deeper story: of land out of balance, of restoration through stewardship and of Indigenous traditions nearly lost. As farmers, scientists and communities reconnect with yaupon, it becomes a bridge between ecology, culture and renewal.

programme.title: The Kennedy Half-Century
programme.desc: The Kennedy Half-Century chronicles the enduring impact of John F. Kennedy's life and policies on the U.S. presidency since JFK's tragic death in 1963. From Lyndon Johnson's Great Society to Ronald Reagan's tax cuts and Cold War strategies, from Bill Clinton's infatuation with Kennedy to the similarities between JFK and Barack Obama in the 2008 presidential campaign, The Kennedy Half-Century explores the legacy of JFK over the past fifty years. Based on the new book by Larry Sabato, the compelling one hour documentary features archival photos of Kennedy's assassination and funeral, historic moments and interviews with major political and media figures, including Bob Schieffer, Ron Reagan Jr., Kathleen Kennedy Townsend, Ari Fleischer, James Carville, Julian Bond, Andrew Bell and Larry Sabato, among others.

programme.title: Perfect 36: When Women Won the Vote
programme.desc: In July of 1920, all eyes were on Nashville, Tennessee as anti- and pro-suffragists each fought for their vision of a socially evolving United States. PERFECT 36: WHEN WOMEN WON THE VOTE chronicles the dramatic vote to ratify the 19th amendment granting women the right to vote, and the years of debate about women's suffrage that preceded it.On July 17, 1920, Carrie Chapman Catt, President of the National American Woman Suffrage Association, arrived to spend a few days in Nashville. She was traveling on the heels of Tennessee Governor A.H. Roberts' announcement of a special session of the state legislature, called at the urging of President Woodrow Wilson. One more state needed to ratify the proposed amendment, and that duty rested solely on the shoulders of Tennessee. Catt's few days dragged into weeks at her headquarters in the Hermitage Hotel, where pro- and anti- suffragists continued to clash in what came to be known as the War of the Roses. Those in favor sported yellow roses, while those against wore red. On the sweltering day of August 18, 1920, the House convened. After two consecutive 48-48 outcomes to table the resolution, it was put to a vote. The votes were coming in neck and neck. At the last minute, 24-year-old freshman representative Harry Burn recalled a letter from his mother received that morning, urging him to, be a good boy and grant women the right to vote. In spite of wearing a red rose, Burn swung his vote, making Tennessee the deciding 36th state to enable passage of the 19th Amendment, and thereby granting women their Constitutional right.

programme.title: Civil War: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Sherman is defeated in Georgia . . . But then defeats the Confederates at Jonesboro and continues his March to the Sea, dealing a psychological blow to the Confederacy and a stunning conclusion to the Western Campaign . . . In November, President Lincoln defeats his opponent McClellan in a landslide election . . . The 13th Amendment abolishing slavery is passed by the House on January 31, 1865. Six weeks later, Abraham Lincoln gives his Second Inaugural Address . . . More than 750,000 Americans, Union and Confederate, perished in the conflict. In the smoldering ash of war, the nation has survived.

programme.title: Civil War: The Untold Story
programme.desc: 1860 presidential election of anti-slavery candidate Abraham Lincoln . . . Thirteen states from the South secede and form the Confederate States of America, led by President Jefferson Davis . . . 1862 Union forces led by General Ulysses S. Grant force the unconditional surrender of Confederate forces at Fort Donelson . . . A Confederate force launches a brutal surprise attack at Shiloh, led by Albert Sidney Johnston. Grants army is within a mile of the Tennessee River and has established a last line of defense . . . Johnston loses his life in the battle.

programme.title: Rick Steves Art of Europe
programme.desc: As the Ice Age glaciers melted, European civilization was born and with it, so was art. From the Stone Age came prehistoric art: mysterious tombs, mighty megaliths, and vivid cave paintings. Then the Egyptians and the Greeks laid the foundations of Western art creating a world of magical gods, massive pyramids, sun-splashed temples, and ever-more-lifelike statues.

programme.title: Rick Steves Art of Europe
programme.desc: The Romans gave Europe its first taste of a common culture and awe-inspiring art. From its groundbreaking architecture to its statues, mosaics, and frescos, Rome engineered bigger and better than anyone before. At its peak, the Roman Empire was a society of unprecedented luxury, with colossal arenas for entertaining the masses and giant monuments to egotistical emperors. And then it fell.

programme.desc: Judy verkündet die Positionen in der berühmten Feld-Aufstellung und sorgt dabei für eine Überraschung. Das Medienkompetenztraining geht nicht bei allen gut. Melissa Rycroft muss entscheiden, wer bleiben darf.

programme.title: Fotos
programme.desc: Von den Kandidatinnen werden Fotos im typischen Dallas-Cowboys-Cheerleader-Outfit gemacht. Später kochen sie zusammen, eine hat Probleme beim Training und eine andere geht nach Hause.

programme.title: Keine Zeit mehr
programme.desc: Kelli und Judy müssen eine schwierige Entscheidung treffen. Zum ersten Mal in dieser Saison tritt die Show Group auf. Charlotte Jones kommt vorbei, um mit den anderen die besten 36 auszuwählen.

programme.title: Nerds Gone Wild
programme.desc: RJs Eltern sind das Wochenende über weg und Jenni übernimmt zu RJs Verwunderung den Job als Babysitterin. Die Lage verschärft sich, als sie das Haus als Location für eine Party ausruft.

programme.title: Es geht wieder los
programme.sub-title: Big Brother geht in die zweite Runde! I Opening Staffel 2
programme.desc: Es ist wieder soweit: Big Brother startet in die zweite Runde! Diesmal ziehen 12 Bewohner in den Container ein. Unter der Leitung von Moderatoren Oliver Geissen und Alexandra Bechtel beginnt der Einzug.

programme.title: Erstes Beschnuppern der Bewohner I Tag 1 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Es ist wieder soweit: Big Brother geht in die zweite Runde. Die Bewohner:innen ziehen im Jahr 2001 in das Big Brother Haus ein, in dem sie die nächsten 106 Tage verbringen werden. Der erste Austausch zwischen den Kandidat:innen findet statt und die erste gemeinsame Nacht steht bevor.

programme.title: Ersten Sticheleien?! I Tag 2 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Tag 2 im Big Brother Haus. Die Bewohner:innen erhalten ihre erste Wochenaufgabe. Sie lernen sich besser kennen und es kommt zu Interessanten Gesprächen. Schon am 2 Tag fließen die ersten Tränen und die ersten Sticheleien starten.

programme.title: Alida's glitschiger Duschmoment! I Tag 3 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Die erste Einkaufsplanung verläuft chaotisch. Danach duschen die Bewohner:innen und es kommt zu einem Vorfall, bei dem Alida vor der Dusche ausrutscht. Die Spannung zwischen Stefanie und Marion bleibt bestehen.

programme.title: Karim im Kampfmodus I Tag 4 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Daniela und Karim haben Spaß beim Anmachen des Wasserschlauchs. Danach machen sich Daniela und Jörg Gedanken über die Nominierung. Bisher hat noch keine Frau im Armdrücken gegen Ebru gewonnen. Ebru fordert Karim zum Armdrücken heraus.

programme.title: Vier Männer,eine Dusche I Tag 5 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Die Bewohner:innen singen und tanzen zusammen, die Stimmung ist super. Die Männer sparen Duschmarken, indem sie zu viert duschen. Stefanie und Marion vertragen sich nach ihrem ersten Streit.

programme.title: Gartenspaß deluxe I Tag 6 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Am Morgen dreht sich das Gesprächsthema um das Rauchen. Die Bewohner:innen bekommen einen Hau-den-Lukas in den Garten und verbringen den Nachmittag damit, zu üben.

programme.title: Die erste Nominierung im Haus! I Entscheidung 1 I Staffel 2
programme.desc: Aleksander Bechtel und Oliver Geissen eröffnen die allererste Live-Entscheidungsrunde im Haus! Special Guest Kim Fischer sorgt für Highlights im Studio, während Tic Tac Toe mit ihrem Hit „Isch liebe disch“ die Bühne rocken.

programme.title: Wildtierfütterung auf den Bahamas?!
programme.desc: Bahamas-Urlaub à la Geiss! Der Tag startet mit dem Füttern von Stachelrochen – doch dann wird es richtig wild: Haie stehen auf dem Plan! Jetzt bloß keine falsche Bewegung machen! (S4 E09)

programme.title: Jetzt wird's wild: Crocodile-Carmen und
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss erkunden die gefährlichen Everglades und wollen sich den Alligatoren und Schlangen stellen! So zumindest der Plan. Anfangs ist weit und breit nichts zu sehen, doch plötzlich sind sie von allen Seiten umzingelt! (S4 E11)

programme.title: "Weihnachtsglocken" im Moulin Rouge!
programme.desc: Während Carmen sich in Paris von den historischen Gebäuden und den Lichtern der Stadt beeindrucken lässt, träumt Robert von den leicht bekleideten Damen des „Moulin Rouge“. (S4 E12)

programme.title: Überraschung! Geheimer Kurztrip für Carmen Geiss'
programme.desc: Robert Geiss hat etwas Großes für den Geburtstag seiner Ehefrau Carmen geplant. Also heißt es: Carmen die Augen verbinden und ins Auto laden. Für seine Liebste ist ihm nämlich nichts zu teuer: Er hat sogar eine Presidential Suite gebucht! (S4 E14)

programme.title: Ciao Venezia! Carmen Geiss' Traum wird endlich wahr...
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss' Geburtstagswochenende nimmt nochmal richtig Fahrt auf! Nächste Aktivität: venezianische Masken bemalen. Während Carmen Geiss ganz filigran den Pinsel schwingt, ist Ehemann Robert Geiss nach einem kompletten Anstrich schon fertig – typisch! (S4 E15)

programme.title: Typisch Geissens! Action statt Entspannung in
programme.desc: Familie Geiss macht einen Wochenendtrip nach Saint-Tropez! Carmen Geiss freut sich auf ein entspanntes Wochenende, aber daraus wird wohl nichts. Ehemann Robert Geiss hat andere Pläne: Ein Boot ist organisiert, und es geht direkt aufs Wasser! (S5 E01)

programme.title: Robert Geiss' neue Karriere: Kart-Profi in Ischgl?!
programme.desc: Vollgas in Ischgl! Robert Geiss hat große Pläne: Beim Summer Opening im Kartfahren will er mit den Profis mithalten. Doch kaum angekommen, wird ihm klar – hier fahren echte Könner! (S5 E02)

programme.title: Party-Alarm: Davina Geiss' XXL-Geburtstag!
programme.desc: Ein richtig großer Tag für Davina Geiss! Heute wird das Geburtstagskind stolze neun Jahre alt! Für Carmen und Robert Geiss heißt das: Zeit für eine absolute Mega-Party! Eine Überraschung jagt die nächste! (S5 E04)

programme.title: Spektakulär: Bulgarien-Reise à la Robert Geiss!
programme.desc: Mit dem Helikopter fliegt die Familie ans Schwarze Meer. Bei diesem Ausblick verschlägt es sogar Carmen Geiss die Sprache! Doch nach all der Ruhe am Strand wird plötzlich der "Ballermann" von Bulgarien anvisiert. (S5 E05)

programme.title: Schock: "Wie kann man denn sowas machen?"
programme.desc: Heute steht für die Geissens eine Bootstour auf dem Programm! Robert Geiss will seinen Kindern endlich zeigen, wie man einen Fisch angelt. Doch plötzlich hört er ein lautes Platschen und Schreie! Opa Reinhold Geiss ist ins Wasser gefallen! (S5 E07)

programme.title: Schock in Bodrum! Robert Geiss verletzt?!
programme.desc: In Bodrum gönnen sich Robert und Carmen Geiss eine wohlverdiente Auszeit. Ein riesiges Luxus-Boot darf dabei natürlich nicht fehlen. Doch die Erholung währt nicht lange – Robert hat sich verletzt! (S5 E08)

programme.title: Totalausfall: Luxus-Villa-Flop auf Ibiza?!
programme.desc: Die Geissens gönnen sich eine Auszeit auf Ibiza. Ein riesiges Luxus-Anwesen gehört dabei natürlich zum Standardprogramm… Doch es gibt ein Problem: Die Klimaanlage des Hauses funktioniert nicht! (S5 E09)

programme.title: Wer wird Ibizas next Po-Model?!
programme.desc: Es geht in die nächste Runde! Carmen und Robert Geiss unterstützen ihren Freund Walter bei einem Model-Casting. Die Models geben Vollgas und dabei wird es feuchtfröhlich! (S5 E10)

programme.title: Action auf hoher See: Robert Geiss verbannt das
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss nehmen auf Monacos Bootmesse alles genau unter die Lupe. Auf dem Wasser soll dann die Post abgehen! Doch dabei stört die Kamera! Also wird diese, samt Kamerateam, einfach vom Boot verwiesen. (S5 E11)

programme.title: Völlig crazy: Opa Geiss in High Heels?!
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert besuchen die Starnacht am Wörthersee, feiern mit Feuerwerk und einem Auftritt von Gregor Glanz. Am nächsten Tag treffen sie Fans für Autogramme und Fotos. Dann wird es peinlich, als Opa Reinhold Carmens High Heels an sich nimmt. (S5 E12)

programme.title: Nervenzusammenbruch? Ein Horrortrip für Carmen Geiss!
programme.desc: Es wird richtig wild! Die Geissens besuchen Seaworld in Orlando und Carmen Geiss muss mit Tochter Davina auf die Achterbahn. Diese entpuppt sich für Carmen als echter Horrortrip... (S5 E13)

programme.title: Robert Geiss lässt seine Frau einfach stehen?!
programme.desc: Shania Geiss' Geburtstagsparty steht an. Carmen Geiss wechselt schnell in den Designerfummel. Doch kaum ist sie fertig, düst Robert einfach los und lässt sie stehen! (S5 E13)

programme.title: Völlig benebelt in Malaysia?
programme.desc: Familie Geiss erkundet Kuala Lumpur – natürlich stilecht mit Luxus-Guide Albert. Der gebürtige Malaysier hat einiges geplant: Der erste Stopp ist ein chinesischer Tempel, wo Carmen und Davina Geiss einen geheimnisvollen Zukunftszettel ziehen. (S5 E14)

programme.title: Tempelhöhle wird zur Mutprobe!
programme.desc: Tourguide Albert hat sich für die Geissens in Kuala Lumpur etwas Besonderes überlegt: die Tempelhöhle! 👀 Doch um dort hinzugelangen, muss die Familie 272 Treppenstufen erklimmen. Carmen Geiss mit Klaustrophobie und Robert Geiss mit Höhenangst.. (S5 E15)

programme.title: Affen-Alarm: Beklaut im Paradies?!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss macht Urlaub auf Pulau Pangkor! Doch plötzlich ertönt ein lauter Schrei! Eine diebische Affenbande hat das Urlaubsdomizil entdeckt! Die Räubermannschaft schnappt sich alles, was nicht niet- und nagelfest ist. (S5 E16)

programme.title: Singapur extrem: Todesstrafe und Rikscha-Wahnsinn!
programme.desc: Die Geissens treffen sich in Singapur mit Tourguide Suzy. Zuerst soll die Metropole auf einer Bootsrundfahrt erkundet werden. Schnell kommt es zu einem äußerst heiklen Thema: Singapurs Gesetze und... die Todesstrafe! (S5 E17)

programme.title: Speedboot-Abzocke auf Barbados?!
programme.desc: Die Geissens verbringen einige Tage auf Barbados, doch statt Ruhe will Robert sofort Action. Beim geplanten Speedboot-Trip läuft vieles anders als erwartet. Seit über zehn Jahren zeigt RTLZWEI ihr Leben zwischen Luxusalltag und exklusiven Events. (S6 E02)

programme.title: Überraschung: Robert Geiss kauft heimlich ein Boot!
programme.desc: Es muss ein Boot her! Und das am besten sofort! Robert Geiss weiß auch schon ganz genau, wo er eins bekommt. Also auf zum Bootsladen. Doch Carmen Geiss traut ihren Augen kaum... wieso steht auf einem der Boote bereits Roberts Name? (S6 E03)

programme.title: Bootsdrama und heiße Cheerleader?!
programme.desc: tress pur! Robert und Carmen Geiss machen mit ihren Kindern und dem neuen Boot eine Spritztour. Doch plötzlich passiert es... Robert fährt auf eine Sandbank! Um sie herum nur Felsen und flaches Wasser. (S6 E04)

programme.title: Horror-Trip nach St. Barth!
programme.desc: Auch in Florida ist das Wetter schließlich manchmal schlecht – und so etwas kommt bei den Geissens gar nicht in die Tüte! Daher verlassen Carmen und Robert Miami in Richtung Karibik. (S6 E05)

programme.title: Romantik in der Karibik: Carmen Geiss schwebt auf
programme.desc: Die Geissens finden in der Karibik eine einsame Insel. Carmen Geiss überlegt kurzerhand, einfach mit der Yacht abzuhauen... Aber dann kommt alles anders - denn Robert hat eine Überraschung für sie! Carmen schwebt sofort auf Wolke 7. (S6 E06)

programme.title: Chaos pur: Reinhold Geiss bringt alle auf die Palme!
programme.desc: Robert und sein Vater Reinhold Geiss waren mit den Kindern "angeln". Leider ohne Erfolg. Die schnelle Lösung: ein Fisch vom Fischmarkt. Doch Carmen Geiss kann man nicht so leicht täuschen... (S6 E08)

programme.title: Zusammenstellung
programme.desc: Eine Zusammenstellung von Highlights aus der 21. Staffel der Graham Norton Show.

programme.title: Teens Turn 21-Years-Ols For 24 Hours
programme.desc: Three immature teens get a taste of adult freedom with a credit card, but their reckless spending and actions quickly land them in trouble with the law. They escape punishment, but a final VR prank reveals they still have much to learn.

programme.title: Kid Cheats In School Fundraiser
programme.desc: Determined to win a Go Kart, competitive teen Eddie cheats in a school fundraiser, lying about sales and rigging the final count. His victory is short-lived when his deceit is exposed, costing him the prize and earning him detention.

programme.title: Girl's ChatGPT Leaked Last Day at School
programme.desc: Forced to wear badges of their GPAs, failing artist Isa and overachiever Brielle team up to replace public shaming with a supportive peer tutoring program.

programme.title: Girl Forced Extreme Diet to Win Comp
programme.desc: After being body-shamed and starved by her ruthless coach, Emma joins a rival team that prioritizes health over winning. Her fueled performance proves that well-being is the true key to success.

programme.title: Student Vandalizes Principal's Car
programme.desc: Adam is framed for vandalizing the principal's car using deepfake technology. He discovers his nerdy classmate William used AI to frame him out of love for Adam's girlfriend, Julia.

programme.title: Teen Shamed for Mom's Mistake
programme.desc: When teacher Rebecca is blamed for a student's DUI crash, her son Marcus faces relentless shaming. He and his girlfriend Sofia uncover a police cover-up, clear her name, and expose the corruption.

programme.title: Mexican Girl Shamed for Bad Spanish
programme.desc: Shamed for her poor Spanish, adopted teen Sofia hides her white parents from her boyfriend's traditional family. When exposed, she embraces her true biological heritage, dumps her boyfriend, and finds pride.

programme.title: Popular Girl Hides Her Depression
programme.desc: Popular Jenna stages her kidnapping to escape the pressure of perfection. Classmate Eli, recognizing her hidden depression from his late sister's tragedy, saves her on a cliff edge just in time.

programme.title: Rich Girl Goes Undercover As Normal Girl
programme.desc: A pampered princess, arranged to marry a superficial prince, seeks freedom in America. There, she falls for a humble, kind boy and learns to stand up for herself, ultimately breaking free from tradition and finding true love.

programme.title: Adopted Girl Becomes Famous Singer
programme.desc: A talented singer in a cruel foster home, Zara's dreams are crushed by her foster sister Fallyn. But with a new friend and popstar Jace's support, Zara finds her voice, exposes Fallyn's deceit, and achieves stardom.

programme.title: Boyfriend Picks Girlfriends Clothes Out Everyday
programme.desc: Jay's strict cultural values clash with his girlfriend Gemma's dreams of a cheerleading scholarship, leading to a breakup. Witnessing his sister's secret passion for cheer, Jay realizes his controlling ways and embraces a more understanding path, hoping to reconcile with Gemma.

programme.title: Most Allergic Kid In The World
programme.desc: Jesse, plagued by severe allergies, avoids romance. When his childhood crush Avery reenters his life, he faces his fears and societal pressures, ultimately choosing love and finding a partner who embraces his unique challenges.

programme.title: Controlling Girlfriend Gets Dumped
programme.desc: Controlling Raji tries to change her boyfriend, John, by forcing him to diet and apply for a law firm job. John finally stands up to her, but she wins him back by offering Lakers box seats and promising to change her ways.

programme.title: Influencer Is Dumped By Famous Girlfriend
programme.desc: Desperate to revive his YouTube channel, Timmy prioritizes collabs with Allison Day over his girlfriend Trish, even missing her birthday. After hitting 10 million subs, he realizes his self-absorption, apologizes, and offers to pay for Trish's dream art school tuition and move to New York with her.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Filmproduzent Rolf Brunner, seine Assistentin Karin Maybach und Castingchef Detlev Harm bei einer Krisensitzung: Für die anstehende internationale Kinofilmproduktion findet sich kein Regisseur. Von Wedel bis Dietl – niemand ist abkömmlich …

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Die Gastgeber Britta und Stefan freuen sich über einen bisher gelungenen Silvesterabend mit Freunden. Als es ums Teilen der Kosten für die fröhliche Pärchenparty geht, schlägt die Stimmung jäh um: sooo viele Garnelen haben die einen gar nicht gegessen …

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Tina lässt sich im Computerladen von Verkäufer Frank beraten. Er empfiehlt die „saugeile“ Grafikkarte. Oder – wenn sie auf Nummer sicher gehen will – eine „hammergeile“. Die wäre dann sowohl für „dies und das“ als auch für „alles Mögliche“ geeignet.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Arbeitsalltag im Großraumbüro: Birte will um ein Uhr in die Mittagspause und fragt in die Runde, ob die Kollegen mitkommen, sich die Titten vergrößern lassen. Die Kollegen sind ehrlich bestürzt, denn einige von Ihnen waren bereits in der Mittagspause …

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Judith und die lebensgroße Ratte Rolf sitzen beim gemeinsamen Essen im Restaurant. Der Kellner bietet als Dessert eine Käseplatte an, was Rolf als Diskriminierungsversuch deutet: „Käse? Weil ich ne Ratte bin, oder was?

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Die Badenixen Nina und Ute sonnen sich, als sie den Strandverkäufer Tom entdecken und heranwinken. Tom ist über und über mit Uhren, Hüten und weiteren Utensilien behängt. Im Gespräch stellt sich heraus, dass er gar nichts verkaufen möchte.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Die besten Sketche aus der vierten Staffel Ladykracher. Natürlich gibt es auch ein Wiedersehen mit der legendären Pimmelnase, dem vergesslichen Tätowierten und der Deutschstunde für Anfänger. Anke Engelke und das große Ladykracher-Special!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Bionade Litschi und Lauchrhabarber-Quiche – so etwas unmännliches gibt es nicht, wenn Anke Engelke die Biergartenbedienung ist. Doch auch als Tennistrainerin kennt sie keine Gnade. Ladykracher ist endlich zurück und wie gewohnt zündet Anke mit ihrem einzigartigen Ensemble wieder ein Feuerwerk an durchgeknallten Sketche ab.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Männer sind wie Tiere – erst recht, wenn es darum geht gegenüber dem Konkurrenten sein Revier zu markieren. Doch auch Frauen können ganz anders – das beweist Anke mal wieder in zahlreichen durchgeknallten Sketchen!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Auf geht's in eine neue Runde voller abgefahrener Sketche bei Ladykracher. In dieser brandneuen Episode brilliert Anke wieder einmal in zig verschiedenen Rollen von der betrügenden Ehegattin ohne schlechtes Gewissen bis zur selbstbewussten Onka.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Wii-Boxen ist der neueste Trend – genau das Richtige für Anke. Schlagkräftig geht es auch in den anderen Sketchen zu : egal, ob Superman Tennis spielt oder der Horrorklassiker „Saw“ parodiert wird – „Ladykracher“ ist einfach unschlagbar witzig.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Als ob der Job im Freizeitpark nicht schon anstrengend genug wäre: ohne das Maskottchen-Kostüm wird es allerdings nicht leichter. Außerdem zeigt Anke, was es bedeutet Opfer des Trickfickers zu werden oder wie Onka eine Yogastunde leitet.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Bonuspunkte an der Kasse kann doch keiner mehr sehen – Koi-Karpfen sind dagegen der letzte Schrei! Das kann man von einer Darmspiegelung nicht gerade sagen, aber der gemeine Arschkriecher muss ja irgendwie wieder raus.

programme.title: Schweizer Flussgeschichten
programme.desc: Hoch oben im Engadin entspringt der Inn – einer der mächtigsten Alpenflüsse – und bahnt sich seinen Weg durch glitzernde Seen, weite Täler und spektakuläre Schluchten. Mal gezähmt, mal wild ist er Lebensraum für Mensch, Tier und Pflanze. Auf rund 100 Kilometern durchquert er die Schweiz, bevor er über Österreich bis zur Donau fließt. Ein Fluss voller Kontraste, Kulturen und Geschichten – vom Ursprung bis zum Schwarzen Meer.

programme.title: Bauern in Europa
programme.desc: Am Westufer des Gardasees, dem „Land, wo die Zitronen blühen", betreibt Elvira Vassalli ein Café, in dem sich fast alles um die Gardasee-Zitrone dreht. Ihr Bruder Horatio verwandelt die saure Frucht in Schokolade, Likör und andere Köstlichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit der Genossenschaft „Riviera dei Limoni" arbeiten sie daran, die verfallenen Zitronengärten wieder zum Leben zu erwecken.

programme.title: Gipfel der Genüsse
programme.desc: Im Nordwesten Sloweniens entspringt die Soca in einer Höhe von 1.600 Metern und schlängelt sich über 140 Kilometer bis hin zum italienischen Mittelmeer. Der Fluss fasziniert mit seinem klaren, türkisblauen Wasser, in dem die Marmorataforelle beheimatet ist, die ein Gewicht von über 20 Kilo erreichen kann. Vor zwölf Jahren übernahmen Ana Ros und Valter Kramar das Gasthaus "Hisa Franko" im Soca-Tal. Trotz fehlender formaler Ausbildung und einiger anfänglicher Fehler zaubert Ana Ros heute regionale Gerichte von höchster Qualität.

programme.title: GEO Reportage

Ein Sehnsuchtsort für Mensch und Tier. Jedes Jahr im Herbst machen hier Zehntausende Kraniche Rast auf ihrem Weg in den Süden. GEO Reportage war den Kranichen auf der Spur.
