programme.desc: Carly suggère à Freddie et Sam de passer plus de temps ensemble et d'apprendre à se connaître. Sam ira donc jouer au petit train avec Freddie et ses copains et Freddie accompagnera Sam visiter son oncle et son cousin en prison. Mais c'est un échec.

programme.title: Lintello
programme.desc: Carly rencontre Kyle, un garçon très intelligent. Pour ne pas paraître stupide à ses yeux, elle étudie et fait des recherches sur Internet avant leur rendez-vous.

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Petit Pépin l'Ancien réussit à faire pousser des fruits et légumes de petite taille. Il demande à Fleur d'Oranger d'écouler sa production. Mais sa boutique ne peut pas accueillir autant de denrées. Fleur d'Oranger redouble d'ingéniosité...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Le chantier du marché couvert a débuté. Les amies de Charlotte s'emparent de la décoration de sa chambre, et pour ne pas les décevoir, celle-ci cède à tous leurs caprices. De son côté, Petit Pépin l'Ancien tente désespérément...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Pour l'inauguration du marché couvert, les amies de Charlotte font venir Cerisette, la plus grande star du rock. Cerisette est en fait une fille toute simple qui rêve qu'on la traite comme une fille ordinaire et pas comme la star que décrit...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Cerisette décide d'enseigner la musique à Fraisi-Paradis pendant ses vacances et d'organiser un récital avec tous ses élèves. Mais Prunetille a le tract et s'ingénie à trouver des moyens de repousser la date du concert. Elle finira par...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Cerisette organise un concours de talents à Fraisi-Paradis. Lili Framboise et Mimi Citron redoublent d'ingéniosité pour tenter de gagner le concours, car elles ont appris qu'une chasseuse de talents assistera au spectacle. Lili Framboise se...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.sub-title: Une étoile de la mode est née
programme.desc: Lili Framboise se rend à un entretien à Mégapomme pour discuter de son avenir dans la mode. Elle revient quelques jours plus tard à Fraisi-Paradis accompagnée d'une productrice d'émission de télé, Marla Maraschino, de Furieusement...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Charlotte participe au concours " Décrivez la destination de vos rêves ". Mais Baba Hortensia comprend à tord qu'elle a réservé des vacances sur une île tropicale de rêve. Incapable de tenir sa langue, elle en parle à toutes ses amies...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Grosse déception à Fraisi-Paradis : les vacances sur l'île tropicale sont reportées à l'année suivante pour cause de fermeture prématurée de la station balnéaire en raison des intempéries. Fleur d'Oranger a alors l'idée de transformer...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les filles s'apprêtent à profiter de leur mini-station balnéaire au bord du lac. Mais voilà que débarque Marla Maraschino, avide de faire un reportage sur les vacances des stars. Cerisette et ses amies se donnent un mal fou pour l'éviter. Et...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Baba Hortensia lit une histoire de sa création aux bébés Petits-Pépins. Celle d'un hiver très peu rigoureux, où la neige fond trop vite et les habitants de Fraisi-Paradis sont bien tristes. Lili Framboise craint de ne pas vendre ses...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: La tempête souffle sur Fraisi-Paradis et les facteurs renoncent à distribuer le courrier. Ce qui n'arrange pas Baba Hortensia, pressée de lire le dernier roman de Patty Persimmone. Elle invente des " patins volants ", des patins à glace...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: C'est le printemps et nos amis de Fraisi-Paradis multiplient les projets. Lili Framboise veut organiser un défilé de mode de sa collection printemps/été. Petit Pépin Mécano, lui, met au point un spectacle de jets d'eau : la Fontaine...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Le printemps est revenu et les filles répètent une nouvelle chanson. Cerisette leur annonce qu'on les attend pour un concert à Mégapomme. Elles sont toutes sont folles de joie à l'idée de partir en tournée, sauf Fleur d'Oranger, très...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon du nom de Coco Berry arrive à Fraisi-Paradis, accompagné d'une ribambelle de chiens. Aucun d'entre eux n'a de maître et Coco Berry cherche à les faire adopter. Il fait rapidement la connaissance de Charlotte et de toutes ses...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Tous les deux fans des livres de la célèbre détective Patty Persimmone, Baba Hortensia et Coco Berry décident d'écrire ensemble leur propre roman policier. Mais Baba Hortensia a des idées bien arrêtées et ne prend pas en compte les...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.sub-title: Le mystérieux mystère du concours canin
programme.desc: Baba Hortensia et Coco Berry reçoivent une mauvaise nouvelle. Leur roman policier a été rejeté par le Fraisi-Mystère Magazine. Loin de les décourager, cette nouvelle les pousse à redoubler d'efforts. Ils décident d'écrire un nouveau roman...

programme.title: Swim
programme.desc: Une famille est prise au piège alors que la maison de vacances qu'elle loue est inondée par la pluie et qu'un requin agressif a réussi à s'y introduire.

programme.title: Java Heat
programme.desc: L'histoire se concentre sur les conséquences d'un attentat-suicide en Indonésie, où un Américain imprudent se faisant passer pour un étudiant diplômé cherche à se venger.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Un virus a décimé l'humanité. Les rescapés tentent de survivre mais ces petits hameaux sont terrorisés par Apocalypta qui contrôle une armée de zombies appelée Copperheads. Une bande hétéroclite de cowboys vont alors unir leurs forces pour les affronter.

programme.title: TAI CHI HERO
programme.desc: À propos des premières années de Yang Luchan, maître de Tai-chi. L'homme qui a fondé le Tai-chi au XIXe siècle et ce qui est aujourd'hui devenu le style de Tai-chi le plus populaire au monde. Le deuxième volet de la trilogie "Tai Chi" poursuit le parcours de Yang Luchan, un enfant prodige qui a aidé à sauver un village des soldats.

programme.title: L'Amour au pied du sapin
programme.desc: Le plan était facile, le travail ne l'était pas. Par une nuit enneigée, une équipe serrée de quatre criminels planifie un vol de routine. Lorsque les choses tournent mal, l'amitié, la loyauté et la confiance sont poussées à leur paroxysme.

programme.title: Un Noël en Alaska
programme.desc: Lorsque la femme d'affaires Jennifer apprend que ses parents seront absents pendant les vacances de fin d'année, elle décide de quitter sa vie animée de citadine à San Francisco, pour visiter l'auberge de sa grand-mère en Alaska dont elle a héritée.

programme.title: Les Douze voeux de Noël
programme.desc: Laura organise une séance avec un coach de vie, qui lui dit de faire 12 vœux pour avoir un changement positif et retrouver sa vie et son chien avant Noël.

programme.title: Un Noël trop cool
programme.desc: Lindsay, 16 ans, décide de donner au Père Noël une cure de jouvence extrême.

programme.title: Magie de noël
programme.desc: Après un accident de voiture, une femme se réveille à Central Park avec un ange, qui lui donne une chance de gagner l'entrée au paradis.Le film est une histoire de découverte et le véritable esprit de Noël.

programme.title: Sakra : La Légende des demi-dieux
programme.desc: Dans la Chine du Xe siècle, Qiao Feng, maître en arts martiaux et héros respecté, est accusé d'un meurtre qu'il n'a pas commis. Contraint à l'exil, il entreprend un périlleux voyage pour rétablir la vérité, affrontant de redoutables ennemis au cœur d'un conflit entre clans rivaux.

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: Inspiré de faits réels. Le 12 août 1967, dans le parc national de Glacier au Montana, l'impensable se produit : la même nuit, à 15 km d'intervalle, surviennent non pas une, mais deux attaques mortelles de grizzli.

programme.title: Orc Wars
programme.desc: Une armée d'Orcs est envoyée dans notre monde pour l'envahir. Un ancien militaire est désigné malgré lui comme étant LE tueur d'Orcs et l'unique sauveur de l'humanité. L'affrontement ultime peut commencer…

programme.title: Battle for Skyark
programme.desc: Dans un monde post-apocalyptique, Rags, un jeune exilé marqué par une prophétie, mène une bande d'orphelins contre des monstres afin de sauver l'humanité et ramener la paix entre la Terre et la cité céleste de Sky Ark.

programme.title: The Boy Behind the Door
programme.desc: Enlevés sur le chemin de l'école, Bobby et Kevin se retrouvent prisonniers d'un ravisseur impitoyable. Après une première évasion, Bobby décide de retourner sauver son ami lorsque surgit une menace encore plus dangereuse. Une course contre la montre où chaque décision peut être fatale.

programme.title: Underwater
programme.desc: Jeanne Clairsen, "Oreille d'Or" dans la marine, est appelée par le Commissaire Delattre, afin qu'elle perce tous les bruits qui apporteraient la preuve qu'une nouvelle victime est bien détenue chez le suspect qu'ils ont mis sur écoute.

programme.title: Yùl et le serpent
programme.desc: Yùl, treize ans, accompagne son grand frère Dino pour conclure un deal avec Mike, petite frappe accompagnée de son dogue argentin. Alors que la situation tourne mal, un étrange serpent apparaît.

programme.title: À demi mot
programme.desc: Quand Laurène et Sacha se réveillent dans les bras l'un de l'autre, leur amour semble être une évidence, jusqu'à ce que les mots viennent s'immiscer dans leur histoire.

programme.title: Mon amoureux
programme.desc: Romain, c'est mon amoureux. On s'embrasse avec la langue. On va se marier, on va vivre ensemble et on va avoir des enfants. On va même avoir des rapports sexuels. Mais bon, aux Eglantines, c'est interdit. Alors samedi, ma petite soeur, elle vient nous chercher en voiture pour nous emmener à la campagne.

programme.title: Vertige
programme.desc: Dans notre monde urbain, le système jette les hommes à terre dans l'indifférence. Mais vue sous un angle nouveau, la ville devient un espace à redécouvrir et à reconstruire.

programme.title: Yulia
programme.desc: Subitement arrachée à ses journaux, Yulia, se retrouve parachutée dans une pièce sans issue avec cinq manettes fixées au mur. En les actionnant, elle déclenche une série d'événements absurdes qui la conduiront à trouver l'âme soeur.

programme.title: Moonkup
programme.desc: Comme toutes les femmes d'Europe, Eva donne son sang pour faire durer la paix avec les vampires. Elle est la fille bâtarde du puissant Monsieur Pire qui a fait fortune dans le transport de l'hémoglobine. Quand Monsieur Pire décide de marier sa fille légitime au fils d'un puissant vampire, Éva profite de la noce pour rendre justice aux femmes, quitte à mettre en danger la paix.

programme.title: La vie sauvage
programme.desc: Arnaud et Nora, trentenaires en vacances, terminent leur weekend en province par une visite d'un parc safari. Tout excités à l'idée de découvrir une faune insolite, ils se comportent comme des enfants et se prennent pour des animaux, oubliant un instant que ces derniers sont en liberté… Entre sexe, folie et barbapapa, le couple ne sortira pas indemne de cette expédition.

programme.title: La Pureté de l'enfance
programme.desc: L'écoute d'une cassette retrouvée transporte la bédéiste Zviane vers son enfance. Basé sur un enregistrement réel, ce film hilarant traduit avec un style ludique l'imaginaire des enfants. Une fenêtre sur le quotidien signée Chroniques du 9e art.

programme.title: Nice
programme.desc: Martial, 17 ans, a fugué à Nice pour venir voir sa mère, chanteuse à la vie chaotique. Près de la maison de celle-ci, il rencontre trois femmes : une employée des Assédic, une ancienne camarade de classe et la propriétaire des lieux. Trois fragments d'éducation sentimentale, trois secrets, trois chansons.

programme.title: Tapette
programme.desc: Alors qu'il est sur le point de s'installer avec sa petite amie, Michel a une montée d'angoisse. Pour éviter de s'engager, il va se persuader qu'il est homosexuel.

programme.title: Journée d'appel
programme.desc: Une bande de jeunes banlieusards passe leur journée d'appel à la caserne de Versailles. L'un d'eux, Chris, arrivé trop tard à la caserne, veut rentrer au quartier, mais Momo, une baltringue de leur cité, le persuade de passer la journée au château de Versailles.

programme.title: Obras
programme.desc: Obras propose, en un unique plan-séquence, un voyage dans le temps et l'espace, une déambulation poétique, graphique et sonore qui traduit visuellement les mutations urbaines, sauvages et irréversibles, à travers la destruction / reconstruction de Barcelone.

programme.title: Ghost Cell
programme.desc: À la fois film scientifique, documentaire et balade onirique, Ghost Cell est une plongée en relief au coeur des entrailles d'un Paris organique vu comme une cellule au travers d'un microscope virtuel.

programme.title: Eclipse
programme.desc: Sur une planète éloignée, deux scientifiques venus analyser le terrain pour ses particularités magnétiques sont confrontés à un phénomène extraordinaire lié à une éclipse de lune.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: Un jeune soldat sans expérience est envoyé à un poste de surveillance, au beau milieu d'un désert.

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Oripeaux
programme.desc: Dans un village isolé, une petite fille se lie d'amitié avec une meute de coyotes. Les villageois mettent brutalement fin à cette relation sans se douter du soulèvement qui les guette

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: La bête
programme.desc: Une jeune femme se caresse. De ses poils naît une bête démesurée, dont le corps épouse et violente le sien.

programme.title: Zoo
programme.desc: Des menstruations de leurs filles à la naissance de leur chien, tout est sous contrôle dans la vie d'Emmanuelle et Olivier Teziev. Mais ce matin Léa, leur fille cadette, n'est pas descendue déjeuner. Sur son lit, à sa place, les Teziev et Emilie, leur aînée, découvrent avec horreur un monstrueux cocon. Progressivement le chaos s'installe.

programme.title: Argile
programme.desc: Alex pose. Une vieille dame sculpte. Une situation normale... si la dame en question n'était pas une aveugle et n'avait pour « voir » que ses mains. Des mains ridées qu'elle pose sur le corps nu de son jeune modèle. Alex va connaître une séance de pose inhabituelle.

programme.title: Fard
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, le monde semble fonctionner de façon efficace et contrôlée...

programme.title: Sept Morts Sur Ordonnance
programme.desc: A dix ans d'intervalle, dans une petite ville de province, le Dr Losseray, excellent chirurgien d'origine modeste, connaît le même destin tragique que son confrère, le Dr Berg. Parce que tous deux ont refusé de faire alliance avec le clan médical dirigé par le professeur Brézé, ils sont acculés au suicide après avoir massacré leurs familles. Les Brézé peuvent ainsi conserver leur monopole en toute honorabilité.

programme.title: Point De Chute
programme.desc: Trois voyous enlèvent une jeune fille de quinze ans, Patricia, pour obtenir de son père le versement d'une rançon. Ils la séquestrent dans une cabane perdue au bord de la mer et la battent. Seul Eddie, un jeune voyou, gardien de la jeune fille, s'insurge contre ces méthodes. A travers un fait divers tragique, le portrait de deux adolescents dans un climat d'angoisse et de violence.

programme.title: Ratchet Et Clank
programme.desc: Ratchet et Clank unissent leur force, intelligence et courage pour lutter contre le maléfique Drek qui veut détruire la galaxie. Avec l'aide des Rangers Galactiques ils vont se lancer dans une aventure spectaculaire ! Ce duo de choc est basé sur la franchise des jeux vidéo Ratchet & Clank de Sony, qui a été écoulée à plus de 13 millions d'exemplaires à travers le monde.

programme.title: Cyrano Et D'artagnan
programme.desc: Deux gascons montent à Paris, Cyrano et d'Artagnan. Le premier entre au service du Roi Louis XIII, le second, devenu Mousquetaire, sert la cause d'Anne d'Autriche. Nous sommes en 1642. Les complots se multiplient à la Cour. Les intrigues amoureuses vont aussi bon train avec deux beautés de l'époque : Ninon dee Lenclos et Marion Delorme.

programme.title: Minamata
programme.desc: Le photographe de guerre W. Eugene Smith retourne au Japon où il documente l'effet dévastateur de l'empoisonnement au mercure dans les communautés côtières.

programme.title: Virgin secrets
programme.desc: Ronnie a tout du jeune homme parfait : il est séduisant, issu d'une famille aisée, et il s'apprête à rejoindre une prestigieuse université. Mais par-dessus tout, il accompagne la fille la plus en vue du lycée, Mélissa, au bal de fin d'année.

programme.title: On sera 2!
programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: The Promotion
programme.desc: Deux gérants adjoints d'un supermarché s'affrontent pour décrocher un poste convoité.

programme.title: The Words
programme.desc: Rory Jansen, jeune auteur new-yorkais, rejeté par les maisons d'édition, peine à lancer sa carrière. En voyage de noces à Paris, son épouse Dora lui offre un porte-documents chiné chez un brocanteur.

programme.title: Une mère diabolique
programme.desc: Jessica, ruinée, tente de récupérer sa fille Allison pour toucher son héritage de 40 millions d'euros.

programme.title: Coup de foudre au manoir
programme.desc: Isabella et Blake organisent une fête au manoir, ignorant les surprises qui les attendent.

programme.title: Mariage sanglant
programme.desc: Pour fuir sa tante, une couturière est prête à tuer la fiancée de l'homme de ses rêves pour l'épouser.

programme.title: L'Amour sous le citronnier
programme.desc: Licenciée, la photographe Becka tente un concours à Serenity Island. Elle y aide Josh, un fermier réticent.

programme.title: Aviator
programme.desc: Un biopic illustrant les premières années de la carrière légendaire du réalisateur et aviateur Howard Hughes, de la fin des années 1920 au milieu des années 1940.

programme.title: L'île de Pascali
programme.desc: Un agent secret en Turquie est persuadé par ses supérieurs de prêter assistance à un couple d'escrocs anglais pour voler une inestimable statue grecque.

programme.title: 6 Minutes to Midnight
programme.desc: Un professeur de littérature et de langues dans une école privée se retrouve pris dans une conspiration nazie.

programme.title: Sex Therapy
programme.desc: Trois accros du sexe suivent un programme en 12 étapes, à New York, pour s'en sortir.

programme.title: Nick Of Time
programme.desc: Un modeste comptable se trouve pris dans un terrible piège lorsque sa fille est enlevée sous ses yeux afin de l'obliger à assassiner une femme politique influente. Il se rend compte que les services de sécurité font partie du complot.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: L'histoire désopilante de l'accord parfait que passent Emma et Adam, basé entièrement sur le sexe et dont la seule règle est : Sex Friends.

programme.title: The Two Jakes
programme.desc: La suite tant attendue du chef-d'oeuvre du film noir, Chinatown. Los Angeles, 1948 - Obtenir les aveux d'une femme bafouée, la confiance d'un mari trompé demande de l'expérience, de la finesse, un sens psychologique aigu...

programme.title: Les Super-héros : Comment ont-ils Conquis le Monde ?
programme.desc: Des comics à Hollywood, l'incroyable ascension des super-héros devenus un phénomène mondial.

programme.title: Stars Connexions
programme.sub-title: Omar Sy, Florence Foresti et Stromaé
programme.desc: Les parcours de Florence Foresti, Omar Sy et Stromae, de leurs débuts au sommet de leur carrière.

programme.title: Stars Connexions
programme.desc: Les destins de Squeezie, Angèle et Kendji Girac, révélés par le web, la musique et le talent.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: Une grande fresque épique et spectaculaire au cœur des aventures d'Ulysse ?

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: Les moments les plus mémorables du cinéma et des célébrités sont classés dans cette émission captivante.

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: Les moments les plus mémorables du cinéma et des célébrités sont classés dans cette émission captivante.

programme.title: Parle tout bas si c'est d'amour
programme.desc: Une prof de SVT, une grand-mère, des parents en colère et un proviseur : Caroline et Olivier, seize ans, aimeraient que leurs parents et l'Education Nationale cessent de leur parler d'amour. Ils s'aiment, mais ils ont peur de ne pas être à la hauteur. Leur première fois, ils la veulent belle.

programme.title: Let's Dance: Davai, tantsyui!
programme.desc: Nikita, jeune danseur talentueux, s'inscrit au concours « Let's Dance » dans l'espoir de gagner le grand prix et ainsi pouvoir payer l'opération dont son petit frère a besoin.

programme.title: Good Advice
programme.desc: Ryan Turner est un jeune banquier-investisseur qui connaît un succès incomparable. Ryan court beaucoup trop les jupons et couche régulièrement avec ses clientes, y compris, malheureusement pour lui, Veronica Simpson, la femme de son plus important client, Donald Simpson.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Prêt à tout pour trouver un sujet d'article intéressant, un journaliste suit une prostituée diplômée de Stanford et s'introduit dans le monde des escorts girls de luxe.

programme.title: Le merveilleux jardin secret de Bella Brown
programme.desc: Bella, jeune femme fantasque, risque l'expulsion si elle ne remet pas son jardin en état. Elle fait alors la rencontre d'Alfie, son voisin bougon et passionné de jardinage, qui va bouleverser sa vie.

programme.title: L'homme de ma vie et moi
programme.desc: Niki anime un podcast bien connu sur les relations amoureuses. Lorsqu'un grand éditeur la contacte pour un éventuel contrat de livre, elle se retrouve en difficulté car le podcast est basé sur sa relation avec un petit ami imaginaire, Monsieur Parfait. Elle a besoin d'un remplaçant...

programme.title: Ava
programme.desc: Ava, 13 ans, apprend qu'elle perdra la vue plus tôt que ce qu'elle espérait, et affronte le problème à sa manière.

programme.title: Ville-Marie
programme.desc: A l'arrêt d'autobus, Thomas Bernard assiste, impuissant, au suicide d'une jeune mère. Ebranlé, l'étudiant en architecture oublie son projet de se rendre à l'aéroport pour accueillir sa mère Sophie Bernard, grande actrice française de passage à Montréal pour le tournage d'un film réalisé par un ancien amant. Tandis que Sophie tente d'entrer en contact avec son fils, qu'elle n'a pas vu depuis trois ans, à l'hôpital Ville-Marie, l'infirmière Marie Santerre réconforte les ambulanciers Pierre et Benoît, qui n'ont pas réussi à sauver la désespérée à l'arrêt d'autobus. Dans les heures qui suivent, Marie, femme blessée, poursuit sa fuite en avant en enchaînant les quarts de travail. Le lendemain, Sophie retrouve enfin Thomas, et l'invite à un dîner d'anniversaire en tête-à-tête. En guise de cadeau, celui-ci demande à sa mère de lui révéler l'identité de son père, qu'il n'a jamais connu. Or, la réponse se trouve dans le film qu'elle est en train de tourner.

programme.title: Team Bride
programme.desc: Hannah McKenzie gère une activité secondaire de création de robes de mariée lorsqu'elle n'est pas occupée par son travail au salon. Lorsque Will Millington, héritier de l'empire du mariage, arrive avec l'intention de redynamiser la marque, ils se retrouvent à travailler ensemble et peut-être même à tomber amoureux...

programme.title: Opération Lidice
programme.desc: Le 27 mai 1942, à Prague, l'officier SS Reinhard Heydrich est victime d'un attentat organisé par la résistance

programme.title: The Neighbor
programme.desc: Un homme d'âge moyen voit sa vie bouleversée par une jolie jeune femme.

programme.title: Un hologramme pour le roi
programme.desc: Un homme accepte le job de sa vie dans le but de vendre une technologie d'hologramme à un monarque.

programme.title: Opération Lidice
programme.desc: Le 27 mai 1942, à Prague, l'officier SS Reinhard Heydrich est victime d'un attentat organisé par la résistance

programme.title: L'amour en trois rendez-vous
programme.desc: Kathy, animatrice radio populaire, rencontre John, créateur d'une application de rencontre, lors d'une émission en direct. Malgré leurs différences, l'alchimie entre eux est immédiate.

programme.title: Le Café de l'amour
programme.desc: La propriétaire d'un café réputé pour faire naître l'amour tente de réconcilier une célébrité abandonnée après sa demande en mariage. Mais à force de vouloir sauver leur couple, elle tombe elle-même sous son charme.

programme.title: Amoureux pour le show
programme.desc: Tara, présentatrice télé en perte de vitesse, accepte de participer à une émission où elle doit épouser un inconnu. Mais en rencontrant Joe, son “mari idéal”, elle commence à douter que tout soit faux.

programme.title: Le Temps des mots, le temps d'aimer
programme.desc: Paige rêve de devenir écrivaine malgré la pression familiale. Lorsque la maison d'édition de sa mère menace de fermer, elle écrit anonymement un roman qui pourrait tout changer… y compris sa relation avec Daniel.

programme.title: Le ranch de mes rêves
programme.desc: Kate, jeune actrice citadine, part vivre dans un ranch pour préparer son prochain rôle. Mais en aidant Hunter à sauver son exploitation, elle découvre une vie et des sentiments inattendus.

programme.title: The Cable Guy
programme.desc: Un rituel urbain séculaire : glissez 50 $ à l'installateur du câble et vous aurez toutes les chaînes de cinéma gratuitement. Mais quand Steven Kovacs (Matthew Broderick) emménage dans un nouvel appartement, il trouve que son installateur (Jim Carrey) n'est pas comme les autres. Il ne veut pas des 50 dollars de Steven. Tout ce qu'il veut, c'est un ami et il n'acceptera pas qu'on lui dise non. Steven est sur le point d'apprendre que le câble gratuit n'existe pas. Son ami indésirable s'introduit de plus en plus dans sa vie, manipule la petite amie de Steven, s'invite dans la maison des parents de Steven et fait finalement jeter Steven en prison. L'installateur du câble sera prêt à tout pour conserver leur amitié. Et Steven découvre qu'il va lui falloir aller très loin pour y mettre fin.

programme.title: Excess Baggage
programme.desc: Emily T. Hope, adolescente mal dans sa peau, tente sans succes de retenir l'attention de son cher papa. Devant ses echecs repetes, elle tente le tout pour le tout et organise son propre kidnapping. Son plan reussit. En deguisant sa voix, elle previent son pere de l'endroit ou il peut la retrouver: dans le coffre de sa propre voiture. Mais Vincent Roche, voleur professionnel, vole le vehicule.

programme.title: Maid in Manhattan
programme.desc: Marisa Ventura est une mère célibataire qui vit seule avec son fils Ty dans le Bronx travaille comme gouvernante dans l'un des palaces les plus luxueux de Manhattan. La jeune femme espère gravir les échelons. La vie de Marisa va bientôt se trouver bouleversée lorsqu'un riche héritier américain qui séjourne pour une semaine dans cet hôtel, se méprend sur son identité.

programme.title: On arrête quand ?
programme.desc: Are We Done Yet? est la suite de la comédie familiale hilarante de Revolution Studios, Are We There Yet? (2005) et reprend l'histoire là où elle s'était arrêtée. Nick Persons (Ice Cube), dorénavant marié à Suzanne (Nia Long), vient d'acheter une maison dans un quartier de banlieue paisible pour échapper au chaos de la ville et fournir plus d'espace à sa nouvelle femme et ses enfants, Lindsey et Kevin (Aleisha Allen et Philip Daniel Bolden). Mais lorsque les réparations de sa nouvelle maison commencent vite à lui coûter plus que prévu et qu'il se retrouve à la merci d'un entrepreneur en bâtiment excentrique (John C. McGinley), le rêve suburbain de Nick se transforme vite en cauchemar.

programme.title: Hitch Expert En Séduction
programme.desc: A New York, Hitch exerce une activité aussi originale que secrète : il aide les plus timides à conquérir la femme de leur vie. Son dernier client, Albert, un comptable, est tombé éperdument amoureux de la célèbre Allegra Cole. En guidant Albert vers le bonheur, Hitch rencontre Sara Melas, une journaliste people qui suit Allegra comme une ombre. Pour Hitch, c'est le coup de foudre, mais les conseils qu'il donne aux autres ne lui suffiront pas forcément, d'autant que la journaliste rêve de démasquer le mystérieux conseiller en séduction dont toute la ville parle…

programme.title: Supernatural Activity
programme.desc: Dans une télé-réalité, Damon Dealer et son équipe de choc sont confrontés, chaque jour, à des phénomènes surnaturels. Cette fois-ci, ces enquêteurs sont sur la plus importante enquête paranormale : une chasse aux sorcières dans une maison hantée.

programme.title: Coup de foudre à Austenland
programme.desc: Le culte que voue Jane Hayes à Jane Austen lui complique singulièrement la vie. Jane dépense toutes ses économies pour un voyage à « Austenland », un centre touristique excentrique où les invités sont plongés au coeur de la régence anglaise.

programme.title: Scary Camp
programme.desc: Sam souffre de trous noirs et ne comprend pas pourquoi il est entouré de gens assassinés. Il se tourne alors vers une amie fan de films d'horreur pour avoir des conseils. Sam doit faire face à une terrible hypothèse : et si c'était lui, l'assassin ?

programme.title: (S)ex List
programme.desc: Anna Faris et Chris Evans se partagent la vedette dans cette comédie sur une femme célibataire qui essaie de trouver le véritable amour en se lançant dans une recherche hilarante pour trouver le meilleur ex-petit ami de sa vie.

programme.title: Demande pardon à Dieu, pas à moi...
programme.desc: Alors que Cjamango est absent de son ranch, six bandits attaquent et tuent tous les membres de sa famille. Bouleversé par cette tragédie, il entreprend de se venger.

programme.title: Duel au Texas
programme.desc: Un étranger en quête de vengeance fait une véritable carnage parmi une bande de bandits impitoyables pour venger le meurtre de sa famille.

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: Le commandant d'un fort texan pendant la guerre civile refuse de se rendre aux Nordistes et tente d'acheter la fille du chef de la tribu indienne locale.

programme.title: La révolte des indiens apaches
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un conflit violent éclate entre des magnats des chemins de fer avides et une tribu d'Apaches, seuls deux hommes peuvent empêcher la guerre : Winnetou et Old Shatterhand.

programme.title: Le trésor des montagnes bleues
programme.desc: Forester, un magnat du pétrole sans scrupules, veut déclencher une guerre entre les tribus indiennes et les Blancs. Old Shatterhand et Winnetou tentent de l'en empêcher.

programme.title: Ardor
programme.desc: Un homme mystérieux surgit de la forêt tropicale argentine pour venir en aide à un pauvre fermier et à sa fille, menacés par une bande de mercenaires engagés pour les forcer à vendre leurs terres.

programme.title: Bravo Django
programme.desc: Envoyé dans le Montana pour traquer des braqueurs de banque, un chasseur de primes prend la place d'un shérif remplaçant qui n'est pas arrivé à destination et se retrouve impliqué dans une guerre territoriale entre agriculteurs et éleveurs.

programme.title: Le Banni
programme.desc: Les légendes occidentales Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday et Billy the Kid s'affrontent pour prévaloir sur la loi et pour gagner les attentions de la vive renarde de campagne, Rio McDonald.

programme.title: Macho Callaghan se déchaîne

programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You're Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

programme.title: Paul Whitehouse & Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE
programme.desc: Comedian Paul Whitehouse and his wife Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE, who has a PhD in neuroscience, discuss emotional regulation and neurodiversity. Mine shares her late ADHD diagnosis at 43 and childhood trauma, while Paul explores how physical health scares have changed his lifestyle. They discuss how the education system needs to change for neurodiverse children, the usefulness of labels, how to calm others with your own behaviour, and why this married couple choose not to live together.

programme.title: Why We Should Abolish Politicians
programme.desc: Yale political scientist Hélène Landemore, author of Politics Without Politicians, argues that the political systems we take for granted are no longer fit for purpose. As trust in politicians reaches historic lows across Britain, Europe and the United States, Landemore makes the case that elections alone may no longer be enough to produce governments that truly represent ordinary people.

programme.title: Who Broke Britain's Energy System?
programme.desc: Arthur Downing, an energy expert, discusses his book Power and the People, which charts the history of British energy and how the system became broken.

programme.title: When Hasan Piker Met Jeremy Corbyn
programme.desc: Jeremy Corbyn is no stranger to media and political pile-ons. Neither is Hasan Piker. Hasan was due to meet Corbyn, the former leader of the Labour Party, but the UK government revoked his and his uncle Cenk Uygur's e-visas, claiming their arrival would not be "conducive to the public good." The interview proceeded regardless.

programme.title: We Teach Old People Gen Z Slang
programme.desc: A group of pensioners attempt to decode the mysterious and ever-evolving slang of Gen Z. From "gyatt" to "rage baiting", and "glizzy", these golden oldies give their unfiltered, often baffled, and always entertaining takes. Will they master the lingo or be left completely gobsmacked? Featuring genuine reactions, unexpected laughs, and a wholesome generational culture clash that's both cringe and heartwarming in equal measure.

programme.title: Trump's Greenland Deal Isn't What You Think
programme.desc: Ava is joined by Scott Lucas to break down the latest developments in Donald Trump's political moves. They discuss Trump's recent trip to New York where he met Andy Burnham face-to-face, and analyse the major story from the UN: the long-awaited "deal" on Greenland.

programme.title: Trump Will Lead To America's Downfall
programme.desc: Owen Jones makes his PolJOE debut to discuss Western decline and his book The Fall of the West. He examines economic, military, and moral crises, from Western support for Israel to Donald Trump and rising authoritarianism. Jones explores the legacy of Iraq, Afghanistan, and Libya, deindustrialisation, stagnant wages, and the financial crash, arguing that decades of concentrated wealth have led to decline.

programme.title: The Dark Money Behind Keir Starmer's Rise
programme.desc: Investigative journalist Peter Geoghegan discusses Labour Together, the organisation that shaped Keir Starmer's leadership project. Geoghegan explains how the group functioned less like a traditional thinktank and more like a political campaign machine backed by significant undeclared funding. That money, he argues, was used to build the polling, messaging, and strategy that underpinned Starmer's rise.

programme.title: The Grand Tour's Francis, Thomas & James Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Ahead of the brand new series of The Grand Tour on Prime, James Engelsman, Thomas Holland and Francis Bourgeois take on the ultimate test of Britishness, with tea making, cars, trains, cereal and plenty of questionable answers along the way.

programme.title: Stranger Things Cast Lift Lid On Final Ending & Much More
programme.desc: The Stranger Things cast including Finn Wolfhard, Caleb McLaughlin, Gaten Matarazzo, and Jamie Campbell Bower lift the lid on the final ending, debate their most iconic hairstyles, react to unexpected Vecna thirst traps and more. From hilarious cast banter to emotional reflections on the show's journey, this interview dives deep into the Upside Down one last time.

programme.title: Ultimate Quiz
programme.sub-title: Sienna Miller vs Nick Mohammed vs Dominic West
programme.desc: Sienna Miller, Dominic West and Nick Mohammed go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The cast of WAR put their careers and general TV and film knowledge to the test, taking on questions about some of their biggest roles and most memorable moments. From The Wire, Ted Lasso and Layer Cake to Burnt, WAR, G.I. Joe and The Affair, do they know their famous lines, recognise the iconic images and remember the details from their own careers?

programme.title: Reform Members Defend Nigel Farage
programme.desc: Nigel Farage is under increasing pressure after senior aides appeared to plot how to bypass electoral laws on foreign donations. But in Birmingham with the party faithful, that doesn't seem to matter. With a general election a mere couple years away, will he ride the storm?

programme.title: Pierce Brosnan Eats Tayto And Talks Hurling
programme.desc: Pierce Brosnan and Amir El-Masry take on a series of tasks as they look to earn their Irish passports. Brosnan teaches Amir about hurling, Irish breakfasts and how Ireland fought against Cromwell. Brosnan and El-Masry are the stars of the film 'Giant', which tells the story of world-famous boxer Prince Naseem 'Naz' Hamed.

programme.title: Old People Try White Claw, Aperol Spritz & Alcoholic Gummies
programme.desc: As tastes evolve, more and more young people are looking beyond the traditional pint. Resident older people are put to the test with some of Gen Z's favourite drinks and trends — from White Claw and Aperol Spritz to alcoholic gummies.

programme.title: Old People Try Dating Apps
programme.desc: Senior friends from JOE HQ try out modern dating apps for the first time, swiping through profiles and creating their own to see what dating is really like in the modern world.

programme.title: Meet The MP Fighting For Socialism In 2026
programme.desc: Six months on from their last sit-down, Poole MP Neil Duncan-Jordan returns to PoliticsJOE at a pivotal moment for Labour's future. With interventions this week from Keir Starmer, Tony Blair, Andy Burnham and Wes Streeting, the battle for Labour's direction is underway. Duncan-Jordan discusses Socialism26, a proposal aimed at reshaping the party's priorities and reconnecting it with voters.

programme.title: Nicholas Galitzine & Camila Mendes Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Camila Mendes and Nicholas Galitzine from Masters of the Universe take on The British Test, tackling Britain's biggest cultural talking points. programme.title: Little People, Big Day
programme.desc: Mark Trombino and Carol Skladany, both of whom are described as “a little couple,” have faced unique challenges due to their height. Mark, who stands at 3 feet 3 inches tall, has adapted to the world around him by using extended pedals in his car, a booster seat, and seeking assistance at gas stations. Carol, at 3 feet 11 inches, had never had a serious boyfriend until age 41 and had given up on her lifelong dream of marriage and motherhood. Despite their individual struggles, they found love with each other, and their journey is documented in the context of preparing for their big day.

programme.title: The Wedding Planners
programme.desc: On an episode of “The Wedding Planners,” two different planners work with brides in different locations to plan their special weddings. Melissa Barrad in Southern California assists Rosie and Nandi in planning their wedding at a golf course overlooking the Pacific Ocean. They focus on details like choosing the best location for sunset photos and selecting floral arrangements. Tammy Cowart, on the opposite coast in Orlando, Florida, deals with Jill and Jack. She faces challenges such as hurricane force winds on the wedding day and a venue that requires significant improvements.

programme.title: Sin City Weddings
programme.desc: Las Vegas, known for its neon-lit allure, attracts over 100,000 couples annually who choose to tie the knot in this vibrant city. Whether eloping or planning a destination wedding, Las Vegas offers a range of options. Couples can opt for simple chapel ceremonies starting at $40, or they can go all out with million-dollar weddings at high-end resorts. And for a truly iconic experience, they can even get married by the legendary Elvis Presley himself. programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Coasts
programme.desc: A cat shark out hunting, guillemots fearlessly jumping from the cliffs of Helgoland, the birth of a snow-white baby seal: the 2,400km of German coastlines are home to a unique diversity of species. Over thousands of years, the slow current of the North Sea has allowed silt to accumulate and form the unique world of the Wadden Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2009. Nowhere else in the world does such a landscape exist that, thanks to the tides, is in a constant state of change. On the Baltic Sea, it's above all the Bodden that are unique. They form a chain of shallow bodies of water connected to the sea by narrow channels. Here in the brackish water, only specialists can survive. The North Sea coast is famed for its extensive mud flats, the Halligen islands which are often submerged in winter and endless sandy beaches and dykes. Seals sun themselves on sandbanks and regenerate after the rigours of hunting. Plum in the middle of the North Sea, the cliffs of Helgoland are a paradise for seabirds like gannets, black-legged kittiwakes and guillemots. For the grey seals, the mating season begins in winter and with it fearsome battles between rival males. The largest bulls weigh in at 300kg and are the biggest mammals in Germany. Hunted mercilessly by fishermen competing for the same fish, for many years the seals had disappeared from Germany's coasts. Now they're under protection and are slowly returning. North and Baltic Seas have retained their original character. The Baltic has Darss, Rügen and Usedom, three of the most beautiful holiday destinations in the country and with the whitest beaches. In autumn, red deer stags stamp majestically along the sand against the foamy backdrop of the Baltic. Peregrine falcons, too, have made coast and islands their home.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The 1970 Challenger, Vanishing Point tribute car is back! programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Road Runners are overrunning the shop! Will continues to train his son Brody as the Graveyard's newest painter. But Mark can't seem to keep himself out of the paint booth, and out of Will's hair. Undaunted by Rocky impressions and saxophone solos, the father/son team lay out FC7 In-Violet on a 1970 V-Code Road Runner, and the A4 Silver on a 1969 Road Runner, and apply the V21 Sport Hood Treatment.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Two 1969 Hemi Charger R/T 4-speed cars arrive at the shop, one still runs, so Mark and Doug go for a spin! Prompting an animated retelling of Doug as a teenager, risking vehicular manslaughter to scam his stepdad into buying him a Charger. Back at the shop, Will continues to train his son Brody, as they paint a 1970 'Cuda, 440 6 bbl 4-speed, in F8 Ivy Green Poly.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Rarely seen among Mopar muscle, the Chrysler A-Bodies have some die-hard fans! A stunning B5 Blue Fire Poly 1969 A-57 'Cuda with a 383 Super Commando, has gone through metal, body, paint, and drivetrain installation. Now arriving in assembly for Justin and Allysa to apply the hood decals that complement this 'Cuda's painted accents. But there's more than one A-Body in the Graveyard - don't forget the real Mr. Norm's 1971 Demon!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The 1971 Road Runner 440-6BBL 4-speed is in assembly, and ready for its drivetrain! Before Doug, Allysa, and Hunter install the engine, Mark shows us an unencumbered view of the pistol-grip shifter and the Hurst competition style 4-speed linkage, in action. With the walking Mopar encyclopedia, Tony D'Agostino, Mark and Doug check out a car that could be worth a cool quarter million, a 1969 Hemi Charger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Three pilot pals want three custom built Mopars - but they want them all done at the same time! A 1970 Plymouth Barracuda Convertible, a 1970 Plymouth Road Runner, and a 1968 Dodge Charger. Meanwhile, the 1969 Road Runner is wheeling through assembly. Doug and Hunter install Cragar SS five spokes, then Justin and Allysa assemble the front grille, headlight bezels, and bumper. Mark takes the 1970 Road Runner Convertible 383 4-speed out for a road test.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: To celebrate the 200th episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark and the Ghoulz visit a private automotive museum! The team checks out this massive collection of cars and shows off some of their favorites. To celebrate this landmark episode, Mark, the Ghoulz, and even the executive producer, talk about some of their favorite memories, including some things that have never been seen on TV!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Graveyard Carz was born of struggle, challenge, and the dream of resurrecting an impossible car - the legendary Phantom 'Cuda! With that reputation making restoration in the rear view, Mark and the Ghoulz took on a bigger challenge: A 1971 Hemi 'Cuda, caught in an explosive garage fire! Every hurdle has been cleared, and this epic race will have come to a close if the restoration passes the owner's approval.

The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World's Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt'?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven't given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.” On the island, Lloyd learns his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen. They meet the playfully deceitful ruler who tells them they are in a tournament where ‘Only one can remain'. When they are spoiled by their posh quarters, they are surprised to find the game is already afoot: Last person to find a Jade Blade is out. After an epic battle of elemental powers, Kai steals the last one from Karlof, who is kicked out of the tournament through a trap door leading to the unknown. Later that night, the Ninja go in search for Zane but come across an underground temple where Chen and his Anacondrai Worshippers steal Karlof's power. Is this a fighting tournament, or a ploy to steal everyone's power?

programme.title: Versus
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. In order to find Zane and get to the bottom of Chen's mysterious plot the Ninja need to stay in the tournament and get past the first round. Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Meanwhile, new Titanium Ninja Zane is locked in a dungeon and has a nightmare about a ferocious Ice Dragon. Guided by the voice of Pixal, he embraces his new technology and escapes his cell, only to find Pixal hasn't fared as well. Though she has no body, he inputs her CPU into his, uniting the two. In an attempt to prevent Jay versus Cole, the Ninja enlist the Master of Mind to help, but are unable to prevent the inevitable. In a gladiator battle, Jay and Cole put aside their feud to throw the match --enraging Chen to send Cole down the mysterious trap door. Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Winds Of Change
programme.desc: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only to discover it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

Then he decided to get out on the street, but could not, as he overate and got stuck in the door. This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Kuonechan is a rising star in Korean R&B circles known for his sweet voice and heartwarming music. After debuting in the music scene with the EP “Repetition” in September 2017 he diligently pursued his career releasing a total of three EPs within a year. He's now actively collaborating with big names in the industry including Baek Yerin Jang Sukhoon Humbert and Fisherman and making his distinctive mark in the industry. This artist recently finished his mandatory military duties and announced a new chapter in his career. In this episode Kuonechan performs his new single “Expression” as well as “Don't be sad” “How Did You” and more to nourish our souls. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer ALi! ALi burst into the music scene in 2005 as a guest vocalist for Leessang. Thanks to her unique voice and expressive vocals she mesmerized the public immediately and then she made her debut as a solo artist in 2009 with the album “After The Love Has Gone.” In the competition program “Immortal Songs” she presented her own covers of various masterpieces including “Leopard of Kilimanjaro” and “I Have a Girlfriend” and gained both popular and critical acclaim. In December last year ALi released the remake album “Adolescence” which is composed of the five songs that had a huge influence on her back in her 20's and 30's to share with listeners how she makes the most of the youngest day of her life. In this episode ALi performs “For lovers who hesitate” “Break away” and “Please wait for me” from her latest album as well as “Eraser” and “The way the light.” Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Grizzly! This artist made his debut in the music industry in 2014 with his first single “D.S.” Since then he has been bringing soulful hits to our lives with his lifting vocals good vibes and aesthetically pleasing music combining R&B soul and pop. Thanks to his talents and passion he has collaborated with many big names in the industry including Dbo Khundi Panda Jaedal Punch nello SOLE and Coogie. On January 5 Grizzly made his way back to the charts with a love song called “Beige coat.” With lyrics about what a guy should do and prepare when he is on his way to meet someone he loves this new song is bound to immerse listeners deep into their feelings. In this episode Grizzly performs his new song “Beige coat” along with “Countryside” “Island” and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet his talented artist!

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
